definition_en: the act of noticing or finding something that is hidden or hard to see
core_image: 黑屋里一束紫外光扫过，原本看不见的痕迹忽然亮起来
scene: 海关人员把行李放上扫描台，屏幕上浮出一个不该有的轮廓。The detection of the hidden compartment took only a minute.
sceneCN: 这里 detection 指「发现」（第 2 个义项：查出故意藏起来的东西）；句意是发现那个暗格只用了一分钟。

senses.title: Noticing something not obvious
senses.definition: the act of noticing something that is present but not easy to see
senses.definitionCN: 注意到某物存在，但它并不容易看见
senses.example: His detection of the small error saved the whole experiment.
senses.exampleCN: 他察觉到那个小错误，救下了整个实验。
senses.why: The thing was already there; only attention had to arrive.
senses.whyCN: 东西本来就在，缺的只是那份注意。

senses.title: Finding something concealed
senses.definition: the act of discovering something that someone has deliberately hidden
senses.definitionCN: 把别人故意藏起来的东西查出来
senses.example: The detection of the hidden compartment took only a minute.
senses.exampleCN: 发现那个暗格只用了一分钟。
senses.why: A cover is only useful while nobody thinks to lift it.
senses.whyCN: 遮盖只在没人想到去掀开时才有用。

senses.title: Testing for a substance
senses.definition: the use of a device or test to learn whether something is present
senses.definitionCN: 用仪器或测试判断某种东西是否存在
senses.example: Sensitive detection is needed for traces this small.
senses.exampleCN: 这么微小的痕迹需要高灵敏度的检测。
senses.why: The human eye is handed over to a machine that never blinks.
senses.whyCN: 人眼被交给一台从不眨眼的机器。

intro.en: Detection comes from Latin detegere, to uncover, built from de-, away, and tegere, to cover, and it reached English through French.
intro.cn: detection 来自拉丁语 detegere，本义是揭开覆盖，由 de-（去掉）与 tegere（覆盖）构成，经法语进入英语。

items.en: Tegere meant to cover, and detegere meant to take the cover off.
items.cn: tegere 指覆盖，detegere 指把覆盖物拿开。

items.en: The participle detectus described anything laid bare to the eye.
items.cn: 分词 detectus 形容任何被摊在眼前的东西。

items.en: English detect first meant to expose a hidden fact.
items.cn: 英语 detect 最初指揭发一桩隐藏的事实。

items.en: Police work gave detection the sense of catching criminals.
items.cn: 警务工作让 detection 带上抓罪犯的意思。

items.en: Science now uses it for finding traces too small to see.
items.cn: 如今科学用它指找出小到看不见的痕迹。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the tect shape, while the meaning group runs from finding to recognizing and showing.
note.cn: 形近组共用 tect 这一段，近义组则从找到一路走到认出与显露。

entries.definition: a person whose job is to investigate crimes
entries.definitionCN: 以调查案件为职业的人

to keep someone or something safe from harm

the act of recognizing what something is

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a cover lifted off a hidden mark and end with a machine reading traces.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从揭开盖住痕迹的布开始，落到读出痕迹的机器。

normal.en: De- takes the cover away, and tegere is the cover itself.
normal.cn: de- 把盖子拿走，tegere 就是那层盖子。

normal.en: A detective is simply a person whose job is to uncover.
normal.cn: detective 不过是把揭示当作职业的人。

normal.en: Early detection means the mark is still small enough to handle.
normal.cn: 早发现，意味着痕迹还小到能处理。

normal.en: A smoke alarm is detection without a nose.
normal.cn: 烟雾报警器是没有鼻子的探测。

normal.en: What is covered wants a light, not a louder shout.
normal.cn: 被盖住的东西需要的是一束光，而不是更大的喊声。

abstract.en: Picture a finger lifting one corner of a cloth.
abstract.cn: 想象一根手指掀起布的一角。

abstract.en: Picture a thin beam crossing a dark room.
abstract.cn: 想象一束细光扫过黑屋。

abstract.en: Picture a print glowing faintly blue on glass.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚指纹在玻璃上泛出淡蓝的光。

examples.en: Early detection of the disease saves many lives.
examples.cn: 及早发现这种病能救很多人的命。

examples.en: The detection of the leak prevented a serious fire.
examples.cn: 发现那处泄漏避免了一场大火。

examples.en: Modern instruments can find traces that eyes miss.
examples.cn: 现代仪器能找出眼睛漏掉的痕迹。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 detection 记成「地泰克神」：de 是去掉，tect 像「盖」，把盖子去掉，就是发现与检测。

root: 来自拉丁语 detegere，由 de-（去掉）与 tegere（覆盖）组成，经法语进入英语。本义是揭开覆盖物让东西露出来，后来用于揭发隐秘之事、侦破案件，也用于仪器检测。

sensesIntro.en: From an eye catching a faint mark, to uncovering what was hidden on purpose, to a machine that senses for us.
sensesIntro.cn: 从眼睛捕捉一道淡痕，到揭出故意藏起的东西，再到替我们感知的机器。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a cover lifted off something that was meant to stay hidden.
core.cn: 核心意象：盖住某物的布被掀开，而那东西本想一直藏着。

branches.en: The first sense is an eye noticing what was not meant to be seen.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是眼睛注意到本不想被看见的东西。

branches.en: The second sense adds intention: someone hid it and someone finds it.
branches.cn: 第二个义项添上意图：有人藏，有人找出来。

branches.en: The third sense hands the noticing over to an instrument.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把这份注意交给仪器。

branches.en: Noticing and uncovering are one act, once passive and once purposeful.
branches.cn: 察觉与揭发是同一个动作，一个被动，一个有意。

branches.en: A detective and a detector answer the same question: is it there?
branches.cn: 侦探与探测器回答同一个问题：它在那儿吗？

intro.en: Detection gathers a family of words about uncovering, sensing and the people who investigate.
intro.cn: detection 聚起一族词，围绕揭开、感知以及查案的人。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin tegere, to cover, and de- reverses it into uncovering.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是拉丁语 tegere（覆盖），前缀 de- 把它反转成揭开。

items.meaning: the act of uncovering or sensing
items.example: The detection of the fault took hours.
items.exampleCN: 查出这个故障花了几个小时。
传感器能察觉极细微的移动。
这种气体几乎察觉不到。

items.example: The error went undetected for years.
items.exampleCN: 这个错误多年未被发现。

items.example: Several detections were recorded that night.
items.exampleCN: 那晚记录下了几次发现。

definition_en: a person, especially a police officer, whose job is to investigate crimes
core_image: 台灯下摊开的卷宗，旁边是一枚装进小纸袋的纽扣
scene: 雨夜的小办公室里，男人按灭烟头，翻开一叠照片。The detective studied the photographs until dawn.
sceneCN: 这里 detective 指「侦探」（第 1 个义项：专门查案的人）；句意是那名侦探研究照片直到天亮。

senses.title: A person who solves crimes
senses.definition: a person whose job is to find out who committed a crime
senses.definitionCN: 以查明谁犯了罪为职业的人
senses.example: The detective questioned every neighbour on the street.
senses.exampleCN: 那名侦探询问了街上的每一位邻居。
senses.why: Someone has to stand between a quiet lie and the truth.
senses.whyCN: 总得有人站在安静的谎言与真相之间。

senses.title: A police investigator
senses.definition: a police officer who collects evidence and follows a case to its end
senses.definitionCN: 收集证据并把案件追到最后的警察
senses.example: A police detective arrived with a thin notebook.
senses.exampleCN: 一位警探带着薄薄的笔记本到了。
senses.why: The same curiosity now wears a badge and follows rules.
senses.whyCN: 同一种好奇心，如今戴上了警徽，也守着规矩。

senses.title: Relating to crime solving
senses.definition: used to describe stories, work or methods connected with solving crimes
senses.definitionCN: 用来形容与查案有关的故事、工作或方法
senses.example: She reads detective novels on the long train ride.
senses.exampleCN: 她在漫长的火车旅途中读侦探小说。
senses.why: The noun lent its name to the shelf it fills.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词把自己的名字借给了摆满它的书架。

intro.en: Detective was built inside English from detect plus -ive, and detect itself goes back to Latin detegere, to uncover.
intro.cn: detective 是在英语内部由 detect 加 -ive 造出来的，而 detect 又可追到拉丁语 detegere（揭开）。

items.en: Detegere joined de-, away, to tegere, to cover, and meant to uncover.
items.cn: detegere 把 de-（去掉）与 tegere（覆盖）拼在一起，意思是揭开。

items.en: Detect entered English as a verb meaning to expose what was hidden.
items.cn: detect 作为动词进入英语，指把隐藏的东西揭出来。

items.en: Britain coined detective for the new plain-clothes police.
items.cn: 英国为新出现的便衣警察造出了 detective 这个词。

items.en: Cheap magazines made the detective a hero of popular fiction.
items.cn: 廉价杂志让侦探成了通俗小说里的英雄。

items.en: The word now covers police officers and private investigators alike.
items.cn: 如今这个词既指警察，也指私人调查者。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the detect stem, and the meaning group names different kinds of people who follow clues.
note.cn: 形近组共用 detect 这个词干，近义组则给出几种循线索查案的人。

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a lamp over an open file and end with a stranger asking quiet questions.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从照着摊开卷宗的台灯开始，落到轻声问话的陌生人。

normal.en: Private or police, the job is the same: assemble the truth.

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 detective 记成「地泰克提夫」：de 是去掉，tect 是盖子，-ive 指人，专门把盖子掀开的人就是侦探。

root: 由英语动词 detect 加后缀 -ive 构成，而 detect 来自拉丁语 detegere（揭开覆盖物）。十九世纪英国为便衣警察造出这个词，后来既指警探，也指私人侦探，并引申出「侦探的」这一形容词用法。

sensesIntro.en: From a person who uncovers, to a police officer on a case, to the stories told about both.

core.cn: 核心意象：一盏台灯、一份卷宗，以及纸袋里封着的一件小东西。

branches.en: The first sense is the person who does the assembling.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是做这次拼合的人。

branches.en: The second sense gives that person a badge.

branches.en: The third sense is the shelf of stories about such work.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是关于这类工作的那一架故事书。

branches.en: A private eye and a police officer share one method.

branches.en: The worker and the fiction about the worker grew up together.
branches.cn: 真实的人与写他的小说是一起长大的。

definition_en: the quality of continuing to try despite difficulty, or the act of deciding something firmly
core_image: 桌下握紧的拳头，脸上却仍旧平静地看着前方
scene: 长跑最后一圈，她的双腿在抖，眼神却没有散。Her determination carried her through the final mile.
sceneCN: 这里 determination 指「决心」（第 1 个义项：坚持到底的意志）；句意是她的决心带她跑完了最后一英里。

senses.title: Firmness of purpose
senses.definition: the quality of continuing to try even when something is difficult
senses.definitionCN: 即使困难也继续尝试的品质
senses.example: Her determination carried her through the final mile.
senses.exampleCN: 她的决心带她跑完了最后一英里。
senses.why: The legs were ready to stop; something above them refused.
senses.whyCN: 双腿已经准备停下，是更上面的什么东西不肯。

senses.title: A firm decision
senses.definition: a formal decision that settles a question for good
senses.definitionCN: 把某个问题彻底定下来的正式决定
senses.example: The committee reached a determination after two hours.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会两小时后作出了决定。
senses.why: A matter is weighed once, then the scale is allowed to rest.
senses.whyCN: 事情称过一次，然后就让秤停下来。

senses.title: Working something out exactly
senses.definition: the act of finding out an amount or a cause precisely
senses.definitionCN: 精确查明某个数量或原因的行为
senses.example: The determination of the cause took several weeks.
senses.exampleCN: 查明原因花了几个星期。
senses.why: To determine is to put a boundary around an unknown.
senses.whyCN: 所谓确定，就是给一片未知画上边界。

intro.en: Determination comes from Latin determinare, to set a limit, built from de- and terminus, a boundary stone, and it passed through French.
intro.cn: determination 来自拉丁语 determinare（划定界限），由 de- 与 terminus（界石）构成，经法语进入英语。

items.en: Terminus meant a boundary stone, and determinare meant to set a limit.
items.cn: terminus 指界石，determinare 指划定界限。

items.en: The word also meant to settle a question by fixing its edges.
items.cn: 这个词也指把问题的边界钉死，从而把它了结。

items.en: French determination carried the sense of a settled decision.
items.cn: 法语 determination 带着「已经定下的决定」这层意思。

items.en: English used it for a legal ruling and for firmness of mind.
items.cn: 英语用它同时表示法律裁决与内心的坚定。

items.en: Science added the exact measurement of an amount or a cause.
items.cn: 科学又添上精确测定数量或原因这一用法。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the termin stem, while the meaning group covers resolve, persistence and decisions.
note.cn: 形近组共用 termin 这个词干，近义组则覆盖决意、坚持与决定。

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a clenched fist under a desk and end with a boundary stone in a field.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从桌下攥紧的拳头开始，落到田野里的一块界石。

normal.en: Terminus is a boundary stone, so to determine is to mark where a thing ends.
normal.cn: terminus 是一块界石，所以 determine 就是标出某物到哪儿为止。

normal.en: Determination is a line you draw and then refuse to move.
normal.cn: 决心就是你画下一条线，然后拒绝挪动它。

normal.en: A firm decision is quiet; it has no need to shout.
normal.cn: 坚定的决定是安静的，它不必喊。

normal.en: The same word settles a debate and measures a cause.
normal.cn: 同一个词既了结争论，也测定原因。

normal.en: Where the stone stands, the argument stops.
normal.cn: 界石立在哪儿，争论就停在哪儿。

examples.en: The result was never really in doubt.

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 determination 记成「地特米内神」：de 是定下，termin 是边界，把边界钉死，就是确定，也是决心。

root: 来自拉丁语 determinare，由 de-（加强）与 terminus（界石、边界）组成，经法语进入英语。本义是划定边界、把问题定死，后来引申为作出决定，又引申为内心的坚定与精确测定。

sensesIntro.en: From a will that will not bend, to a question closed for good, to an amount measured exactly.
sensesIntro.cn: 从不肯弯折的意志，到被彻底了结的问题，再到被精确测出的数量。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a boundary stone driven into the ground and a hand that will not move it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块界石被钉进地里，而有一只手不肯挪动它。

branches.en: The first sense is the will that keeps standing at the stone.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是始终守在界石旁的那股意志。

branches.en: The second sense is the moment the boundary closes a debate.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是边界把争论关上的那一刻。

branches.en: The third sense is the measuring that finds where the edge really is.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是找出边界究竟在哪里的测量。

branches.en: A settled decision and a steady will are the same line seen twice.
branches.cn: 已定的决定与稳定的意志，是同一条线被看了两次。

branches.en: To decide and to measure both put an end to vagueness.
branches.cn: 作决定与作测量，都在终结含糊。

intro.en: Determination has a family built on the Latin boundary stone and on the act of fixing a limit.

latinIntro.en: The base is terminus, a boundary, and de- plus -ation turn it into the act of setting limits.

senses.title: Find out exactly
senses.definition: to discover a fact or an amount by careful study
senses.definitionCN: 通过仔细研究弄清一个事实或数量
senses.example: Tests will determine the cause of the fault.
senses.exampleCN: 测试将查明故障的原因。
senses.why: The answer is already there; you only fix its outline.
senses.whyCN: 答案本来就在那里，你只是把它的轮廓钉住。

senses.title: Control the result
senses.definition: to be the fact that decides what something will be like
senses.definitionCN: 成为决定某事物会是什么样子的那个因素
senses.example: Location often determines the price of a house.
senses.exampleCN: 地段常常决定一套房子的价格。
senses.why: One strong fact can set the boundary for all the rest.
senses.whyCN: 一个强有力的事实，能为其余一切划出边界。

intro.en: Determine comes from Latin determinare, to set a boundary, formed from de- and terminus, a boundary stone, and it came through French.
intro.cn: determine 来自拉丁语 determinare（划定边界），由 de- 与 terminus（界石）构成，经法语进入英语。

items.en: Terminus was the stone that marked where a field ended.
items.cn: terminus 就是标出田地到哪儿为止的那块石头。

items.en: Determinare meant to fix that limit and so to settle a matter.
items.cn: determinare 指把这条界限钉住，从而把事情了结。

items.en: French determiner kept both the legal and the everyday sense.
items.cn: 法语 determiner 同时保留了法律与日常两层用法。

items.en: English used it for deciding a question and for fixing a date.
items.cn: 英语用它表示裁决问题，也表示确定日期。

items.en: Science made it the standard verb for finding a value.
items.cn: 科学让它成为表示求出一个数值的常用动词。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the termin shape, and the meaning group moves from deciding to proving and controlling.
note.cn: 形近组共用 termin 的形状，近义组则从作出决定走到证实与支配。

entries.definition: firmness of purpose or a settled decision
entries.definitionCN: 意志的坚定或已定的决定

entries.definition: having a strong wish to do something
entries.definitionCN: 怀着强烈意愿去做某事的

entries.definition: coming at the end of something

to find out a fact for certain
to end a doubt or an argument

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a pen pressed onto a map and end with a price tag that explains everything.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一支笔压在地图上开始，落到一张解释一切的价签。

normal.en: To determine is to put a terminus, a boundary, around a question.
normal.cn: determine 就是给一个问题围上 terminus，也就是边界。

normal.en: A date is determined; a cause is determined; both stop the guessing.
normal.cn: 日期要定，原因要查，两件事都在终止猜测。

normal.en: What determines a house price often sits outside the house.
normal.cn: 决定房价的东西，常常在房子外面。

normal.en: Write the line down and the choice stops being a mood.
normal.cn: 把那条线写下来，选择就不再只是一种心情。

normal.en: The map is large, but one firm stroke makes it small.
normal.cn: 地图很大，但坚定的一笔就让它变小。

abstract.en: Picture a pen pressing a dark line across paper.
abstract.cn: 想象一支笔在纸上压出一道深线。

abstract.en: Picture a row of choices narrowing to one door.
abstract.cn: 想象一排选择渐渐收窄成一扇门。

abstract.en: Picture a small stone that decides where two fields meet.
abstract.cn: 想象一块小石头决定两块田在哪儿相接。

examples.en: They determined the route before sunrise.
examples.cn: 他们在日出前定下了路线。

examples.en: Tests will determine the cause of the fault.
examples.cn: 测试将查明故障的原因。

examples.en: She was determined to finish the race.
examples.cn: 她下定决心要跑完这场比赛。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 determine 记成「地特敏」：de 是定下，termin 是边界，把边界一钉，事情就定下来、也查清楚了。

root: 来自拉丁语 determinare，由 de-（加强）与 terminus（界石、边界）组成，经古法语 determiner 进入英语。本义是划定界限，引申为把问题定下来、作出决定，再引申为查明与支配。

sensesIntro.en: From drawing a line through a choice, to fixing the outline of a fact, to being the fact that rules the rest.
sensesIntro.cn: 从在众多选择中划下一道线，到钉住一个事实的轮廓，再到成为支配其余一切的那个事实。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a pen pressing a firm line across a map.
core.cn: 核心意象：一支笔在地图上压出一道坚定的线。

branches.en: The first sense is the stroke that turns thinking into a choice.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是把思考变成选择的那一笔。

branches.en: The second sense is the same stroke drawn around a hidden fact.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是围着隐藏事实画下的同一笔。

branches.en: The third sense is a line so strong that other things must follow it.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是一条强到别的都得顺着它走的线。

branches.en: Deciding and discovering both end with a boundary that holds.
branches.cn: 作决定与查真相，最后都落到一条立得住的边界上。

branches.en: What you find out often becomes what controls the outcome.
branches.cn: 你查明的东西，常常就成了支配结果的东西。

intro.en: Determine stands at the centre of a family about limits, decisions and exact findings.
intro.cn: determine 站在一族词的中心，这族词关于界限、决定与精确查明。

latinIntro.en: The base is terminus, a boundary stone, and de- gives the act of fixing it.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是 terminus（界石），前缀 de- 给出「把它钉住」这个动作。

items.meaning: the act of settling a matter

definition_en: to grow or to make something grow into a larger, fuller or better form
core_image: 一张卷起的底片浸进药水，影像一点点显出来
scene: 暗房里红灯亮着，白纸在水盘里轻轻晃，山影慢慢浮上来。The image began to develop after a few seconds.
sceneCN: 这里 develop 指「显影」（第 2 个义项：影像在药水里渐渐显出）；句意是几秒之后影像开始显出来。

senses.title: Grow into a larger form
senses.definition: to grow or change into something bigger or more advanced
senses.definitionCN: 成长或变化为更大、更先进的样子
senses.example: The small town developed into a busy port.
senses.exampleCN: 这个小镇发展成了一座繁忙的港口。
senses.why: Nothing is built in one day; the shape arrives in layers.
senses.whyCN: 没有东西是一天建成的，形状是一层层到来的。

senses.title: Become visible on film
senses.definition: to become visible on film or paper through a chemical process
senses.definitionCN: 通过化学过程在胶片或相纸上显现出来
senses.example: The image began to develop after a few seconds.
senses.exampleCN: 几秒之后影像开始显出来。
senses.why: The picture was already on the film, waiting for the liquid.
senses.whyCN: 画面早已在底片上，只等着那盘药水。

senses.title: Build up a skill or habit
senses.definition: to gradually acquire a skill, habit or quality
senses.definitionCN: 逐渐获得一种技能、习惯或品质
senses.example: Children develop language skills very quickly.
senses.exampleCN: 儿童培养语言技能非常快。
senses.why: A skill grows the way a plant does, by small daily additions.
senses.whyCN: 技能的生长像植物，靠每天一点点加上去。

intro.en: Develop comes from French desveloper, to unwrap, built from des- and a word for wrapping, and English took it up in the seventeenth century.
intro.cn: develop 来自法语 desveloper（打开包裹），由 des- 与表示包裹的词根构成，十七世纪进入英语。

items.en: Desveloper meant to unwrap something that had been rolled up.
items.cn: desveloper 指把卷起来包好的东西打开。

items.en: French developper added the sense of unfolding over time.
items.cn: 法语 developper 又添上「随时间慢慢展开」的意思。

items.en: English develop first meant to bring out what was hidden.
items.cn: 英语 develop 最初指把藏着的东西带出来。

items.en: Photography gave it the sense of an image appearing in liquid.
items.cn: 摄影让它带上影像在药水里浮现的意思。

items.en: It now covers growth, skills, land and new products.
items.cn: 如今它覆盖成长、技能、土地与新产品。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the develop stem, while the meaning group moves from growing to widening and evolving.
note.cn: 形近组共用 develop 这个词干，近义组则从生长走到扩张与演变。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a film curled inside its roll and end with a child learning words.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从胶卷里卷着的底片开始，落到一个学说话的孩子。

normal.en: To develop is first to unwrap, then to let the shape appear.
normal.cn: develop 先解开包裹，再让形状自己出现。

normal.en: A town and a photograph both need time in the bath.
normal.cn: 小镇与照片，都需要在药水里泡够时间。

normal.en: A habit is built from days that look almost the same.
normal.cn: 习惯是用一个又一个看起来差不多的日子搭起来的。

normal.en: Nothing shouts while it develops; growth is quiet work.
normal.cn: 发展中的东西从不喊，成长是安静的工作。

normal.en: The negative holds the picture before the eye can see it.
normal.cn: 在眼睛看见之前，底片就已经握着那幅画面。

abstract.en: Picture a dark room lit only by a red lamp.
abstract.cn: 想象一间只亮着红灯的暗房。

abstract.en: Picture a hand rocking a tray of liquid slowly.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手慢慢摇动一盘药水。

abstract.en: Picture a child repeating one new word all afternoon.
abstract.cn: 想象一个孩子整个下午反复念一个新词。

examples.en: The small town developed into a busy port.
examples.cn: 这个小镇发展成了一座繁忙的港口。

examples.en: Children develop language skills very quickly.
examples.cn: 儿童培养语言技能非常快。

examples.en: The film needs ten minutes to develop properly.
examples.cn: 底片需要十分钟才能正常显影。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 develop 记成「地维勒普」：de 是打开，velop 像卷起的包裹，把包裹打开，东西就一点点发展、显出来。

root: 来自古法语 desveloper，由 des-（打开）与表示包裹的词根组成，本义是解开卷起的东西，十七世纪进入英语。从「展开」引申为事物逐渐成长成形，再用于摄影显影、技能培养与土地开发。

sensesIntro.en: From a wrapped thing opened out, to a picture rising in liquid, to a skill built day by day.
sensesIntro.cn: 从包着的东西被打开，到画面在药水里浮起，再到一天天搭起的技能。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: something rolled up slowly opening into a full picture.
core.cn: 核心意象：卷起的东西慢慢展开成一幅完整的画面。

branches.en: The first sense is a place or thing opening into a bigger form.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是一个地方或事物展开成更大的样子。

branches.en: The second sense is a picture opening out of blank film.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是一幅画从空白底片里展开。

branches.en: The third sense is a skill unfolding inside a person.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是一种技能在一个人身上展开。

branches.en: A town and a photograph both reveal a shape that was waiting.
branches.cn: 小镇与照片，都在显出一个早已等着的形状。

branches.en: Places and people develop by the same slow unfolding.
branches.cn: 地方和人，都是靠同一种缓慢展开而发展。

intro.en: Develop grows a large family around unwrapping, growth and building.
intro.cn: develop 长出一大族词，围绕展开、成长与建设。

latinIntro.en: The French base means to unwrap, and the modern family keeps that picture of something opening out.
latinIntro.cn: 它的法语词基意为打开包裹，现代这一族词都保留着「东西展开」的画面。

senses.title: The process of growing
senses.definition: the process by which something grows or changes over time
senses.definitionCN: 某事物随时间成长或变化的过程
senses.example: Economic development changed the whole region.
senses.exampleCN: 经济发展改变了整个地区。
senses.why: A process has no single moment; it is a direction, not a dot.
senses.whyCN: 过程没有单独的一刻，它是一个方向，而不是一个点。

senses.title: Building on land
senses.definition: the work of preparing land or resources so that they can be used
senses.definitionCN: 把土地或资源整理出来以便使用的工作

senses.exampleCN: 老港区的开发花了五年。
senses.why: Empty ground is a promise that someone has to keep with concrete.
senses.whyCN: 空地是一个承诺，得有人用混凝土去兑现。

senses.title: A new event or stage
senses.definition: a new event that changes a situation or adds information
senses.definitionCN: 改变局势或补充信息的新事件
senses.example: We are waiting for the latest development in the case.
senses.exampleCN: 我们在等这个案件的最新进展。
senses.why: A story moves forward one revealed piece at a time.
senses.whyCN: 一个故事是一次揭开一块地往前走的。

intro.en: Development comes from French developpement, built on developper, to unwrap, and English adopted it in the eighteenth century.

items.cn: 英语用 development 表示计划或故事的逐步展开。

items.en: Industry and biology made it the standard word for growth.
items.cn: 工业与生物学让它成为表示成长的标准词。

items.en: It now also names a group of new buildings on a site.

note.en: The look-alike group shares the develop stem, and the meaning group covers growth, progress and expansion.

sensesIntro.en: From a process unfolding over years, to land turned into buildings, to one new piece of news.
