items.cn: developper 指把合着的东西打开、展开。

items.en: Development first named the unfolding of a plan or a living thing.
items.cn: development 最初指计划或生物一步一步展开。

items.en: The suffix -al turned the noun into an adjective.
items.cn: 后缀 -al 把这个名词变成了形容词。

items.en: Psychology gave the word a central place in describing stages of growth.
items.cn: 心理学让这个词在描述成长阶段时占据中心位置。

items.en: It now covers biology, education and economic policy alike.
items.cn: 如今它同时覆盖生物学、教育与经济政策。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the develop family, while the meaning group describes things that are still forming.
note.cn: 形近组同属 develop 这一族，近义组则形容仍在成形的事物。

entries.definition: the process of growing or building
having reached an advanced stage
still growing or improving
having a strong effect on how something grows
entries.definitionCN: 对某物的成长有强烈影响的

entries.definition: relating to slow natural change
entries.definitionCN: 与缓慢的自然变化有关的

entries.definition: increasing in size or amount

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with pencil marks on a clinic wall and end with a plan that is still a sketch.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从诊所墙上的铅笔线开始，落到一份还是草图的计划。

normal.en: Development plus -al gives you the adjective for anything still unfolding.
normal.cn: development 加上 -al，就是形容「仍在展开」的形容词。

normal.en: A child and an economy both have stages, and both keep records.
normal.cn: 孩子与经济都有阶段，也都留着记录。

normal.en: A milestone is a date written on a wall.
normal.cn: 里程碑就是写在墙上的一道日期。

normal.en: What is developmental is not yet finished, and that is the point.
normal.cn: 说某物处在成长阶段，就是它还没完成，而这正是关键。

normal.en: The pencil line rises slowly; nobody watches it rise.
normal.cn: 铅笔线慢慢升高，没人一直盯着它升。

abstract.en: Picture a door frame marked with small horizontal lines.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇门框上刻着一道道短横线。

abstract.en: Picture a notebook where each year takes one page.
abstract.cn: 想象一本笔记本，每年占一页。

abstract.en: Picture a clay figure still soft in the middle.
abstract.cn: 想象一个中间还软着的泥人。

examples.en: The doctor checked the child's developmental milestones.
examples.cn: 医生检查了孩子的发育里程碑。

examples.en: The report examines developmental policy in rural areas.
examples.cn: 这份报告考察农村地区的发展政策。

examples.en: The plan is still at a developmental stage.
examples.cn: 这个计划仍处在成长阶段。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 developmental 记成「地维勒普门头」：develop 是展开，-ment 是过程，-al 是形容词尾巴，合起来就是与成长过程有关的。

root: 由 develop 加 -ment 构成名词 development，再加形容词后缀 -al 而成。词根可追到法语 developper（打开包裹），本义是展开。十九世纪起用于描述生物个体的发育，二十世纪又扩展到心理学、教育与社会发展。

sensesIntro.en: From a body keeping its own growth calendar, to a region changing, to a plan that is still soft.
sensesIntro.cn: 从身体记着自己的成长日历，到一个地区在改变，再到一份还软着的计划。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: small pencil marks climbing a wall year after year.
core.cn: 核心意象：一道道铅笔线年复一年地往墙上爬。

branches.en: The first sense is the body writing those marks.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是身体写下那些线。

branches.en: The second sense is a whole society making the same climb.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是一整个社会在爬同样的坡。

branches.en: The third sense is the soft middle before the shape is fixed.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是形状固定之前那段软软的中间期。

branches.en: A child and a region are both read by their stages.
branches.cn: 孩子与地区，都靠各自的阶段被读懂。

branches.en: Policy and a sketch both belong to the unfinished side.
branches.cn: 政策与草图，都属于尚未完成的那一边。

intro.en: Developmental sits at the adjective end of a family built on growth.
intro.cn: developmental 站在这一族词里形容词的那一端，这族词都建在成长上。

latinIntro.en: The stem means to unwrap, and -ment plus -al turn that action into a quality.
latinIntro.cn: 词干意为打开包裹，-ment 与 -al 把这个动作变成一个性质。

items.exampleCN: 这是一个发育方面的问题。
这个孩子在发育上已经准备好。
开发者资助了这项研究。
这是一个发展中的领域。
这些技能仍未发展起来。

definition_en: a machine or tool made for a particular purpose
core_image: 桌上一个拆开的小机器，线圈和齿轮裸露在外
scene: 他拧开外壳，里面的线圈和齿轮露出来，桌上散着小螺丝。The device measures the moisture in the soil.
sceneCN: 这里 device 指「装置」（第 1 个义项：为特定用途做的小机器）；句意是这个装置测量土壤里的湿度。

senses.title: A piece of equipment
senses.definition: a machine or tool made for a particular job
senses.definitionCN: 为某项特定工作而制造的机器或工具
senses.example: The device measures the moisture in the soil.
senses.exampleCN: 这个装置测量土壤里的湿度。
senses.why: Human hands cannot stay in the field all year, so a small machine does.
senses.whyCN: 人的手没法整年守在田里，于是让一台小机器守着。

senses.title: A method or trick
senses.definition: a plan or trick used to get a particular result
senses.definitionCN: 为得到某个结果而用的计策或花招
senses.example: Silence was just a device to make us talk.
senses.exampleCN: 沉默只是一种让我们开口的手段。
senses.why: A plan can work like a tool even when it has no parts.
senses.whyCN: 一个计策即使没有零件，也能像工具那样起作用。

senses.title: A literary technique
senses.definition: a particular way of writing that produces a chosen effect
senses.definitionCN: 为产生某种效果而采用的特定写法
senses.example: The writer uses repetition as a poetic device.
senses.exampleCN: 这位作家把重复当作一种诗歌手法。
senses.why: Words can be arranged as carefully as gears.
senses.whyCN: 词语也能像齿轮那样被仔细排布。

intro.en: Device comes from Old French devis, a plan or division, which grew from Latin dividere, to divide, and it split from the verb devise.
intro.cn: device 来自古法语 devis（计划、划分），源头是拉丁语 dividere（分开），后来与动词 devise 分了家。

items.en: Dividere meant to divide or separate a whole into parts.
items.cn: dividere 指把一个整体分开、切成几部分。

items.en: Devis named a plan, a division of work or a design.
items.cn: devis 指一份计划、一种分工或一个设计。

items.en: English device first meant a plan or a heraldic design.
items.cn: 英语 device 最初指计划或纹章图案。

items.en: The sense shifted from the plan to the thing built from it.
items.cn: 词义从计划本身转到了照计划造出来的东西。

items.en: It now means any small machine, and also a trick or a method.
items.cn: 如今它指任何小型机器，也指花招或方法。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the vis shape, while the meaning group names useful objects and tools.
note.cn: 形近组共用 vis 这一段，近义组则给出有用的小物件与工具。

entries.definition: to invent a plan or a method
not direct or honest
an opinion about what someone should do
entries.definitionCN: 关于某人该怎么做的一种意见

entries.definition: a small useful machine
a tool used for careful work
an object held to do a job

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a cracked-open casing on a table and end with a writer counting repeated words.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从桌上一个撬开的外壳开始，落到一位反复数词的作家。

normal.en: A device begins as a devis, a plan drawn before any part exists.
normal.cn: device 起初只是一个 devis，一张还没有零件时就画好的图。

normal.en: Take one letter away and the noun becomes the verb devise.
normal.cn: 拿掉一个字母，名词就变成动词 devise。

normal.en: Anything with a switch can be called a device today.
normal.cn: 今天任何带开关的东西都能叫 device。

normal.en: Silence can be a device too, with no wires at all.
normal.cn: 沉默也能是一种手段，一根线都不用。

normal.en: A repeated phrase is a device the ear remembers.
normal.cn: 重复的句子是一种耳朵记得住的手法。

abstract.en: Picture a screwdriver beside four loose screws.
abstract.cn: 想象一把螺丝刀旁边放着四颗松开的螺丝。

abstract.en: Picture a blue light blinking on a small plastic box.
abstract.cn: 想象一个小塑料盒上闪着蓝灯。

abstract.en: Picture the same word printed five times down a page.
abstract.cn: 想象同一个词在纸上竖着印了五遍。

examples.en: The device measures the moisture in the soil.
examples.cn: 这个装置测量土壤里的湿度。

examples.en: Silence was just a device to make us talk.
examples.cn: 沉默只是一种让我们开口的手段。

examples.en: The writer uses repetition as a poetic device.
examples.cn: 这位作家把重复当作一种诗歌手法。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 device 记成「地歪死」：de 是分开，vis 是看，把东西分开来看，看清结构再装成一件装置。

root: 来自古法语 devis（计划、划分），源头是拉丁语 dividere（分开），与动词 devise 同源后在英语中分化。本义是计划或设计，十六世纪起转指照设计造出的物件，再引申为手段与文学手法。

sensesIntro.en: From a plan drawn on paper, to the machine built from it, to a trick or a turn of style.
sensesIntro.cn: 从画在纸上的计划，到照它造出的机器，再到一个花招或一种笔法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small machine opened on a table, its parts laid bare.
core.cn: 核心意象：一台小机器在桌上被拆开，零件都露在外面。

branches.en: The first sense is the plan turned into hardware.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是计划变成了硬件。

branches.en: The second sense is a plan that needs no parts at all.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是根本不需要零件的计划。

branches.en: The third sense is a plan made of words.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是用词语做成的计划。

branches.en: A machine and a trick both exist to get a result.
branches.cn: 机器与花招，都是为得到一个结果而存在。

branches.en: A trick and a literary device both shape how you respond.
branches.cn: 花招与文学手法，都在塑造你的反应。

intro.en: Device belongs to a family about planning, dividing and building something useful.
intro.cn: device 属于一族词，围绕计划、划分与造出有用的东西。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base dividere means to divide, and the French plan word devis grew from it.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词基 dividere 意为分开，法语里表示计划的 devis 就是从它长出来的。

items.meaning: a thing made from a plan
more than one piece of equipment
to invent a plan or method
items.exampleCN: 他们设计了一个简单的测试。
这个游戏设计得很巧妙。

items.example: Devising the rules took a week.
The deviser of the game is unknown.
items.exampleCN: 这个游戏的设计者不详。

items.example: He took a devious route home.
items.exampleCN: 他绕了一条弯路上回家。

definition_en: the most powerful evil spirit, or a wicked or mischievous person
core_image: 炉火猛地一亮，墙上投下一具带角的影子
scene: 老人指着壁画上那个长角的影子，讲起村里流传很久的传说。The old story says the devil lives under the bridge.
sceneCN: 这里 devil 指「魔鬼」（第 1 个义项：传说中邪恶的精灵）；句意是那个古老的故事说魔鬼住在桥下。

senses.title: The great evil spirit
senses.definition: the most powerful evil spirit in many religions
senses.definitionCN: 许多宗教中力量最强的邪恶精灵
senses.example: The old story says the devil lives under the bridge.
senses.exampleCN: 那个古老的故事说魔鬼住在桥下。
senses.why: A village needs one face to put on everything it fears.
senses.whyCN: 一个村子需要一张脸，用来安放它所有的恐惧。

senses.title: A wicked or sorry person
senses.definition: a cruel person, or a person in a very sorry state
senses.definitionCN: 残忍的人，或处境极为可怜的人
senses.example: The poor devil had lost his home and his job.
senses.exampleCN: 那个可怜的家伙失去了房子和工作。
senses.why: The heaviest word in the room gets borrowed for plain misery.
senses.whyCN: 屋里最重的那个词，常被借来说寻常的苦。

senses.title: A mischievous child
senses.definition: a child who behaves in a playful and slightly annoying way
senses.definitionCN: 行为顽皮、有点让人头疼的孩子
senses.example: You little devil, you hid my keys again.
senses.exampleCN: 你这个小淘气，又把我的钥匙藏起来了。
senses.why: The same word softens into affection once the horns are toys.
senses.whyCN: 等那对角变成玩具，同一个词就软成了疼爱。

intro.en: Devil comes from Greek diabolos, a slanderer, through Latin diabolus and Old English deofol.
intro.cn: devil 来自希腊语 diabolos（诽谤者），经拉丁语 diabolus 与古英语 deofol 进入英语。

items.en: Diabolos meant a slanderer, one who throws words across to divide people.
items.cn: diabolos 指诽谤者，即把话扔过去让人分裂的人。

items.en: Latin diabolus took the word over as the name of the chief evil spirit.
items.cn: 拉丁语 diabolus 接过这个词，用作首要恶灵的名字。

items.en: Deofol entered English with Christian teaching.
items.cn: deofol 随基督教教义进入英语。

items.en: The word spread into curses, proverbs and everyday scolding.
items.cn: 这个词扩展进咒骂、谚语与日常责骂里。

items.en: It now also teases a naughty child or pities a poor man.
items.cn: 如今它也用来打趣淘气的孩子，或同情可怜的人。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the devil stem or sound, and the meaning group names evil spirits.
note.cn: 形近组共用 devil 的词干或读音，近义组则指各种邪恶精灵。

entries.definition: very bad or harmful
like a devil, or very difficult
wicked behaviour or magic
an evil spirit
a very cruel person
the chief evil spirit in the Bible

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a horned shadow on a wall and end with a child laughing behind a curtain.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从墙上带角的影子开始，落到帘子后面偷笑的孩子。

normal.en: The Greek word meant slanderer, so the devil began as a whisperer.
normal.cn: 那个希腊词意为诽谤者，所以魔鬼最初是个说悄悄话的人。

normal.en: One word carries both the terror and the teasing.
normal.cn: 同一个词，既装着恐惧，也装着打趣。

normal.en: A poor devil is a man whose luck has run out.
normal.cn: a poor devil 就是运气用光了的男人。

normal.en: The devil in a story always arrives with a bargain.
normal.cn: 故事里的魔鬼，总是带着一桩交易上场。

normal.en: Small horns on a child are only a costume.
normal.cn: 孩子头上的小角，不过是一套装扮。

abstract.en: Picture a shadow with two pointed horns.
abstract.cn: 想象一个带两只尖角的影子。

abstract.en: Picture a hand offering a contract across a table.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手隔着桌子递来一份契约。

abstract.en: Picture keys hidden under a cushion.
abstract.cn: 想象钥匙被藏在坐垫下面。

examples.en: The old story says the devil lives under the bridge.
examples.cn: 那个古老的故事说魔鬼住在桥下。

examples.en: The poor devil had lost his home and his job.
examples.cn: 那个可怜的家伙失去了房子和工作。

examples.en: You little devil, you hid my keys again.
examples.cn: 你这个小淘气，又把我的钥匙藏起来了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 devil 记成「得我」：de 是向下，vil 像「歪」，心思一路向下歪，就成了魔鬼。

root: 来自希腊语 diabolos（诽谤者、挑拨者），经拉丁语 diabolus 与古英语 deofol 进入英语。本义是宗教中的首要恶灵，后来用于骂人、表示恶棍，也用来打趣淘气的孩子或同情处境可怜的人。

sensesIntro.en: From a spirit that whispers division, to a man whose luck has failed, to a small child with a grin.
sensesIntro.cn: 从低声挑拨的灵，到运气耗尽的人，再到咧嘴笑的小孩。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a horned shadow thrown on a wall by firelight.
core.cn: 核心意象：火光在墙上投下一个带角的影子。

branches.en: The first sense is the shadow that religion gave a name.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是宗教给了名字的那个影子。

branches.en: The second sense turns that name onto a man who suffers.
branches.cn: 第二个义项把这个名字转到受苦的人身上。

branches.en: The third sense shrinks the horns to toy size.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把角缩成了玩具大小。

branches.en: The great evil and an ordinary wretch share one word.
branches.cn: 大恶与寻常可怜人，共用一个词。

branches.en: Terror and fondness can sit in the same syllable.
branches.cn: 恐惧与疼爱，能坐在同一个音节里。

intro.en: Devil has a family of adjectives and nouns built on the same old image.
intro.cn: devil 有一族形容词与名词，建在同一个古老画面上。

latinIntro.en: The Greek base means slanderer, and the family keeps both the evil and the playful tone.
latinIntro.cn: 它的希腊词基意为诽谤者，这一族词同时保留邪恶与顽皮两种口气。

items.example: The devil appears in many tales.
items.exampleCN: 魔鬼出现在许多故事里。

items.example: The play is full of devils.
The boys were full of devilment.

items.exampleCN: 村民们把这事归咎于邪术。

items.example: There was devilishness in his eyes.

items.exampleCN: 延误一直困扰着这个项目。

definition_en: to invent or plan something by thinking carefully
core_image: 桌上摊着草图，铅笔在纸上改了又改
scene: 几个人围着白板，把方案擦了又写，一直弄到天亮。They devised a plan to cut costs without losing staff.
sceneCN: 这里 devise 指「设计」（第 1 个义项：想出并安排出一个方案）；句意是他们设计出一个既降成本又不裁员的方案。

senses.title: Invent a plan
senses.definition: to invent a plan or method by thinking carefully
senses.definitionCN: 经过仔细思考发明出一个方案或方法
senses.example: They devised a plan to cut costs without losing staff.
senses.exampleCN: 他们设计出一个既降成本又不裁员的方案。
senses.why: A plan does not exist until someone draws its first line.
senses.whyCN: 在有人画出第一道线之前，方案并不存在。

senses.title: Think up a clever way
senses.definition: to find a clever way of doing something difficult
senses.definitionCN: 为做成一件难事找出一个巧妙的办法
senses.example: She devised a trick to open the locked door.
senses.exampleCN: 她想出一个打开锁门的巧办法。
senses.why: The obstacle stays the same; the new path is the invention.
senses.whyCN: 障碍没有变，被发明出来的是那条新路。

senses.title: Arrange a formal system
senses.definition: to create and arrange a formal system, rule or document
senses.definitionCN: 制定并安排好一套正式的制度、规则或文件
senses.example: The committee devised new rules for the contest.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会为比赛拟订了新规则。
senses.why: Rules are a machine made of sentences, and someone must build it.
senses.whyCN: 规则是用句子做成的机器，总得有人把它造出来。

intro.en: Devise comes from Old French deviser, to arrange or talk over, which grew from Latin dividere, to divide, and it shares a root with device.
intro.cn: devise 来自古法语 deviser（安排、商议），源头是拉丁语 dividere（分开），与 device 同源。

items.en: Dividere meant to divide a whole into parts.
items.cn: dividere 指把一个整体分成几部分。

items.en: Deviser meant to arrange, discuss or plan something in parts.
items.cn: deviser 指把事情分块安排、商议或计划。

items.en: English devise first meant to plan or to bequeath property.
items.cn: 英语 devise 最初指筹划，也指遗赠财产。

items.en: The planning sense grew stronger and the legal sense faded.
items.cn: 计划这一层越来越强，法律遗赠那层渐渐淡出。

items.en: It now means to invent a method, a system or a clever answer.
items.cn: 如今它指发明一种方法、一套制度或一个巧妙的答案。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the vis sound, while the meaning group moves from inventing to contriving and drafting.
note.cn: 形近组共用 vis 这一段音，近义组则从发明走到设法与拟订。

entries.definition: a machine made for a purpose
entries.definitionCN: 为某种用途制造的机器

entries.definition: indirect or not honest
a suggestion about what to do
to create something that did not exist
entries.definitionCN: 造出原本不存在的东西

entries.definition: to manage to do something by clever planning
entries.definitionCN: 靠巧妙的安排设法做到

entries.definition: to express an idea in a clear plan
entries.definitionCN: 把想法写成清晰的方案

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a whiteboard covered in crossed-out lines and end with a page of new rules.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从写满涂改线的白板开始，落到一页新规则。

normal.en: Device is the thing; devise is the act of planning it.
normal.cn: device 是那个东西，devise 是把它计划出来的动作。

normal.en: The ending decides: a hiss for the noun, a buzz for the verb.
normal.cn: 词尾定词性：名词收清音，动词收浊音。

normal.en: To devise is to divide a hard job into small steps.
normal.cn: devise 就是把一件难活切成小步。

normal.en: A locked door invites a devised trick.
normal.cn: 一扇锁着的门，正好邀请一个想出来的巧办法。

normal.en: Rules are sentences arranged until they work.
normal.cn: 规则就是被排到能用的句子。

abstract.en: Picture a hand erasing half a line on a whiteboard.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手擦掉白板上半条线。

abstract.en: Picture three cups on a table and a coin underneath.
abstract.cn: 想象桌上三只杯子，其中一只下面压着硬币。

abstract.en: Picture a page of numbered rules with one blank line.
abstract.cn: 想象一页编号的规则，其中留着一行空白。

examples.en: They devised a plan to cut costs without losing staff.
examples.cn: 他们设计出一个既降成本又不裁员的方案。

examples.en: She devised a trick to open the locked door.
examples.cn: 她想出一个打开锁门的巧办法。

examples.en: The committee devised new rules for the contest.
examples.cn: 委员会为比赛拟订了新规则。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 devise 记成「地歪兹」：de 是分开，vis 是看，把难题拆开来看，就能设计出办法。

root: 来自古法语 deviser（安排、商议），源头是拉丁语 dividere（分开），与 device 同源。本义是把事情分块安排、筹划，后来法律上的遗赠义淡出，主要表示设计方法、想出办法与拟订制度。

sensesIntro.en: From drawing a first line of a plan, to finding a clever way past an obstacle, to writing rules that work.
sensesIntro.cn: 从画下方案的第一道线，到为障碍找一条巧路，再到写出能用的规则。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a pencil crossing out a line and drawing it again.
core.cn: 核心意象：一支铅笔划掉一条线，又重新画一条。

branches.en: The first sense is the sketch becoming a plan.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是草图变成一个方案。

branches.en: The second sense is the clever turn that gets past a wall.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是绕过一堵墙的那个巧劲。

branches.en: The third sense is the plan written as rules.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是写成规则的方案。

branches.en: A plan and a trick are both shapes drawn by thought.
branches.cn: 方案与巧计，都是思考画出来的形状。

branches.en: A private sketch becomes a public system through words.
branches.cn: 私下的草图，靠文字变成公共的制度。

intro.en: Devise shares a family with device, and both grow from the idea of dividing and arranging.
intro.cn: devise 与 device 同属一族，二者都从「分开、安排」这个意思长出来。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base dividere means to divide, and the French verb added the sense of planning.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词基 dividere 意为分开，法语动词又添上计划的意思。

items.example: They devise new games each year.
items.exampleCN: 他们每年都设计新游戏。
这个测试是精心设计的。
这样的方案是设计得出来的。

items.example: The device fits in one hand.

items.exampleCN: 这些装置共用一个充电器。
这条路弯弯绕绕地往上去。

definition_en: to give all or most of your time and energy to something
core_image: 台灯下摊开的书，旁边放着一杯早已凉透的茶
scene: 深夜的书房只剩一盏台灯，桌上的茶早已凉透。She devoted every evening to studying old maps.
sceneCN: 这里 devote 指「致力于」（第 1 个义项：把时间和精力全给某件事）；句意是她每个晚上都用来研究古地图。

senses.title: Give time and energy
senses.definition: to give most of your time and energy to an activity
senses.definitionCN: 把大部分时间和精力投入某项活动
senses.example: She devoted every evening to studying old maps.
senses.exampleCN: 她每个晚上都用来研究古地图。
senses.why: Time is the one thing you can only spend once, so giving it is a real gift.
senses.whyCN: 时间只能花一次，所以把它给出去才是真的给。

senses.title: Give yourself fully
senses.definition: to give yourself completely to a person, cause or duty
senses.definitionCN: 把自己完全交给某个人、某项事业或某种责任
senses.example: He devoted his life to caring for the poor.
senses.exampleCN: 他把一生献给了照顾穷人。
senses.why: A life laid down on one purpose is the oldest kind of offering.
senses.whyCN: 把一生铺在一个目标上，是最古老的一种奉献。

senses.title: Set aside for one purpose
senses.definition: to give a place, page or period completely to one subject
senses.definitionCN: 把某处空间、某页或某段时间完全留给一个主题
senses.example: The last chapter is devoted to local birds.
senses.exampleCN: 最后一章专门讲本地的鸟。
senses.why: A marked space is a promise that this subject will be met.
senses.whyCN: 划出来的一块地方，是「一定会谈这个」的承诺。

intro.en: Devote comes from Latin devovere, to vow away, built from de- and vovere, to vow, and it entered English through French.
intro.cn: devote 来自拉丁语 devovere（许愿献出），由 de- 与 vovere（发誓）构成，经法语进入英语。

items.en: Vovere meant to make a solemn vow.
items.cn: vovere 指郑重地立誓。

items.en: Devovere meant to vow something away, often to the gods.
items.cn: devovere 指把某物许愿献出去，常是献给神。

items.en: Devotio named the act of dedication, and also a curse.
items.cn: devotio 指奉献这一行为，也曾带诅咒之意。

items.en: English devote came to mean giving oneself to a worthy purpose.
items.cn: 英语 devote 渐渐指把自己交给一个值得的目标。

items.en: It now covers time, attention, whole lives and even single chapters.
items.cn: 如今它覆盖时间、注意力、一生，甚至单独的一章。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the devot stem, while the meaning group moves from pledging to committing and consecrating.
note.cn: 形近组共用 devot 这个词干，近义组则从许诺走到投入与奉献。

entries.definition: deep love or loyalty
loving and loyal
a keen follower of something
to give time or effort to a purpose
entries.definitionCN: 把时间或努力给某个目标

entries.definition: to promise to give yourself to something
to make something holy by a ceremony

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a lamp over one open book and end with a chapter given to a single subject.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从照着一本摊开的书的台灯开始，落到专门留给一个主题的一章。

normal.en: To devote is to make a vow and then pay it in hours.
normal.cn: devote 就是先立一个誓，再用小时去还。

normal.en: The tea goes cold because the book is warmer.
normal.cn: 茶凉了，是因为那本书更热。

normal.en: A whole life can be given to one small duty.
normal.cn: 整条命也能交给一件小小的责任。

normal.en: A chapter devoted to birds is a room built for them.
normal.cn: 专门讲鸟的一章，就是为它们盖的一间房。

normal.en: Attention is the modern form of the old offering.
normal.cn: 注意力，就是古老奉献的现代样式。

abstract.en: Picture a lamp with a dark ring on the shade.
abstract.cn: 想象一盏灯罩上有一圈焦痕的台灯。

abstract.en: Picture a hand closing a book at two in the morning.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手在凌晨两点合上书。

abstract.en: Picture an empty chair pulled close to a desk.
abstract.cn: 想象一把空椅子被拉近书桌。

examples.en: She devoted every evening to studying old maps.
examples.cn: 她每个晚上都用来研究古地图。

examples.en: He devoted his life to caring for the poor.
examples.cn: 他把一生献给了照顾穷人。

examples.en: The last chapter is devoted to local birds.
examples.cn: 最后一章专门讲本地的鸟。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 devote 记成「地沃特」：de 是向下，vot 是发誓，低头立誓把时间交出去，就是致力于与献身。

root: 来自拉丁语 devovere，由 de-（向下、彻底）与 vovere（立誓）组成，经法语进入英语。本义是许愿献出，常指献给神明，十六世纪起转为把自己交给某个目标，再引申为把时间、空间或篇幅专门留给某事物。

sensesIntro.en: From a vow paid in hours, to a whole life handed over, to one chapter set aside for one subject.
sensesIntro.cn: 从用小时去还的誓，到交出整条命，再到为一件事留出的一章。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a lamp burning late over a single open book.
core.cn: 核心意象：一盏灯为一本摊开的书亮到很晚。

branches.en: The first sense is the hours handed over one by one.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是一个小时一个小时交出去。

branches.en: The second sense is the whole of a life handed over at once.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是把整条命一次交出去。

branches.en: The third sense is a space marked off for one subject.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是为一个主题划出来的一块地方。

branches.en: Hours and a lifetime differ only in how many payments are made.
branches.cn: 小时与一生，只差在付了多少次。

branches.en: A given life and a given page both say: this matters most.
branches.cn: 交出的一生与交出的一页都在说：这个最重要。

intro.en: Devote has a family built on vows, loyalty and the giving of oneself.
intro.cn: devote 有一族词，建在誓言、忠诚与交出自己之上。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin vovere, to vow, and de- adds the sense of giving away completely.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是拉丁语 vovere（立誓），前缀 de- 添上完全交出的意思。

items.exampleCN: 他们投入很多小时练习。

items.example: He is a devotee of old films.
He devotes Sundays to his family.
Devoting a year to travel changed her.
items.exampleCN: 用一年去旅行改变了她。

definition_en: deep love and loyalty, or the act of giving yourself to something
core_image: 神龛前一小盏长明灯，油快尽了还亮着
scene: 小教堂里那盏灯整夜亮着，守夜的人换了一个又一个。Her devotion to the old school never faded.
sceneCN: 这里 devotion 指「挚爱」（第 2 个义项：深厚的感情与忠诚）；句意是她对那所老学校的挚爱从未消退。

senses.title: Giving yourself to a cause
senses.definition: the act of giving your time and energy completely to something
senses.definitionCN: 把自己的时间与精力完全投入某事物的行为
senses.example: His devotion to the research left little time for sleep.
senses.exampleCN: 他对这项研究的投入让他几乎没时间睡觉。
senses.why: A cause can hold a person the way a fire holds a room.
senses.whyCN: 一项事业能占据一个人，就像火占据一间屋。

senses.title: Deep love and loyalty
senses.definition: strong love and loyalty toward a person or thing
senses.definitionCN: 对某人或某物深厚的爱与忠诚
senses.example: Her devotion to the old school never faded.
senses.exampleCN: 她对那所老学校的挚爱从未消退。
senses.why: Love that keeps returning is love that has become a habit of the heart.
senses.whyCN: 不断回来的爱，已经成了心里的习惯。

senses.title: Religious faithfulness
senses.definition: strong religious feeling shown in prayer and practice
senses.definitionCN: 在祈祷与修行中表现出的强烈宗教情感
senses.example: The old woman's devotion was visible in her daily prayers.
senses.exampleCN: 那位老妇人的虔诚在她每日的祈祷里看得见。
senses.why: A small flame kept alive says more than a loud sermon.
senses.whyCN: 一盏被守住的小火，比一场响亮的布道说得更多。

intro.en: Devotion comes from Latin devotio, a vow or dedication, from devovere, to vow away, and it entered English through French.
intro.cn: devotion 来自拉丁语 devotio（许愿、奉献），源自动词 devovere（许愿献出），经法语进入英语。

items.en: Devotio first named a solemn vow that set a person apart.
items.cn: devotio 最初指把人分别出来的郑重誓言。

items.en: It could also mean a curse, when a person was vowed to harm.
items.cn: 当一个人被许愿交给伤害时，它也能指诅咒。

items.en: French devotion narrowed to religious dedication.
items.cn: 法语 devotion 收窄为宗教上的虔敬。

items.en: English used it for worship and for loyalty to a person.
items.cn: 英语用它表示礼拜，也表示对人的忠诚。

items.en: It now covers love, duty, study and any steady attachment.
items.cn: 如今它覆盖爱、责任、学业以及任何稳定的依恋。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the devot stem, and the meaning group names loyalty, commitment and piety.
note.cn: 形近组共用 devot 这个词干，近义组则指忠诚、投入与虔敬。

entries.definition: to give time or energy to something
entries.definitionCN: 把时间或精力给某事物

entries.definition: showing deep love or loyalty
a very keen supporter
faithfulness to a person or group
entries.definitionCN: 对某人或某群体的忠实

entries.definition: the act of giving time to a purpose
deep respect shown in religion
entries.definitionCN: 在宗教中表现出的深切敬意

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a small flame in a chapel and end with a teacher who never stops caring.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从小教堂里的一点火苗开始，落到一位从不停下关心的老师。

normal.en: Devotion is the noun of a promise that kept being paid.
normal.cn: devotion 是一个一直有人去还的承诺的名词。

normal.en: Love becomes devotion when it comes back the next morning.
normal.cn: 爱在第二天早上还回来，就成了挚爱。

normal.en: The oil is low, and the flame still stands.
normal.cn: 油快见底了，火苗还立着。

normal.en: A quiet room can hold more prayer than a full one.
normal.cn: 一间安静的屋子，能装下比满屋人更多的祈祷。

normal.en: Duty done daily looks dull and is the hardest kind.
normal.cn: 每天做的责任看着很闷，却也是最难的一种。

abstract.en: Picture a red glass cup holding one small flame.
abstract.cn: 想象一只红玻璃杯盛着一小簇火苗。

abstract.en: Picture a hand pouring the last of the oil.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手倒进最后一点油。

abstract.en: Picture a desk used so long that the varnish is gone.
abstract.cn: 想象一张用得太久、漆都磨没了的书桌。

examples.en: His devotion to the research left little time for sleep.
examples.cn: 他对这项研究的投入让他几乎没时间睡觉。

examples.en: Her devotion to the old school never faded.
examples.cn: 她对那所老学校的挚爱从未消退。

examples.en: The old woman's devotion was visible in her daily prayers.
examples.cn: 那位老妇人的虔诚在她每日的祈祷里看得见。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 devotion 记成「地沃神」：de 是交给，vot 是誓愿，-ion 是状态，把心交给一个誓愿，就是献身与挚爱。

root: 来自拉丁语 devotio，源自动词 devovere（许愿献出），由 de-（彻底）与 vovere（立誓）组成，经法语进入英语。本义是郑重许愿、分别出来献给神，后来用于宗教虔敬，也扩展到对人的挚爱与对事业的献身。

sensesIntro.en: From hours given to a cause, to love that keeps returning, to a small flame kept burning.
sensesIntro.cn: 从把时间交给一项事业，到不断回来的爱，再到一盏被守住的小火。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small lamp kept alight in front of a shrine.
core.cn: 核心意象：神龛前一小盏一直亮着的灯。

branches.en: The first sense is the effort that keeps being given.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是不断被交出去的那份力气。

branches.en: The second sense is the warmth that makes the giving easy.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是让这份给予变得容易的温度。

branches.en: The third sense is the flame that the giving is aimed at.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是这份给予所朝向的那簇火。

branches.en: Effort without love burns out, and love without effort cools.
branches.cn: 没有爱的投入会烧尽，没有投入的爱会变凉。

branches.en: A person and a faith can both be loved with the same steadiness.
branches.cn: 对一个人与对一种信仰，能用同一种稳定去爱。

intro.en: Devotion belongs to a family about vows, steady love and faithful practice.
intro.cn: devotion 属于一族词，围绕誓言、稳定的爱与忠实的修行。

latinIntro.en: The base is vovere, to vow, and de- marks the offering as complete.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是 vovere（立誓），前缀 de- 表示这份奉献是彻底的。

items.example: She is a devotee of jazz.

items.exampleCN: 他的虔敬让修士们印象深刻。

definition_en: to find out what illness or problem someone or something has
core_image: 医生把片子举到灯前，用笔尖点住那片阴影
scene: 医生把片子举到灯前，用笔尖轻轻点了点那片阴影。The doctor diagnosed the illness as a rare infection.
sceneCN: 这里 diagnose 指「诊断」（第 1 个义项：判断出得的是什么病）；句意是医生诊断这种病是一种罕见的感染。

senses.title: Identify an illness
senses.definition: to find out what illness a person has by examining them
senses.definitionCN: 通过检查判断一个人得的是什么病
senses.example: The doctor diagnosed the illness as a rare infection.
senses.exampleCN: 医生诊断这种病是一种罕见的感染。
senses.why: A name is the first medicine: once the enemy is known, the fight can start.
senses.whyCN: 名字是第一味药：敌人一旦被认出，仗就能打起来。

senses.title: Find the cause of a fault
senses.definition: to find out the cause of a problem in a machine or system
senses.definitionCN: 找出机器或系统中出现问题的原因
senses.example: Engineers diagnosed the fault in less than an hour.
senses.exampleCN: 工程师不到一小时就判断出了故障所在。
senses.why: An engine cannot describe its pain, so someone must read the signs.
senses.whyCN: 发动机说不出哪里疼，只能由人去读那些迹象。

senses.title: Describe the nature of something
senses.definition: to state what something is after careful study
senses.definitionCN: 经过仔细研究后说出某事物究竟是什么
senses.example: The report diagnosed the company's weakness as poor planning.
senses.exampleCN: 报告判定这家公司的弱点是计划不周。
senses.why: The same eye that reads a body can read an organisation.
senses.whyCN: 能读懂身体的那双眼，也能读懂一个组织。

intro.en: Diagnose comes from Greek diagignoskein, to know thoroughly or tell apart, built from dia- and gignoskein, to know.
intro.cn: diagnose 来自希腊语 diagignoskein（彻底认识、分辨），由 dia- 与 gignoskein（知道）构成。

items.en: Gignoskein meant to know, and dia- added the sense of thorough separation.
items.cn: gignoskein 指知道，前缀 dia- 添上彻底分辨的意思。

items.en: Doctors used the word for telling one disease from another.
items.cn: 医生用它表示把一种病与另一种病分辨开来。

items.en: Medical Latin kept diagnosis as the name of that judgement.
items.cn: 医学拉丁语保留 diagnosis 作为这种判断的名称。

items.en: English diagnose appeared later, built back from diagnosis.
items.cn: 英语 diagnose 出现较晚，是从 diagnosis 反推造出的动词。

items.en: It now covers illnesses, machines, companies and whole systems.
items.cn: 如今它覆盖疾病、机器、公司以及整个系统。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the dia- opening, while the meaning group moves from identifying to determining and detecting.
note.cn: 形近组共用 dia- 开头，近义组则从辨认走到确定与察觉。

entries.definition: a judgement about what is wrong
used to find out what is wrong
running from one corner to another
entries.definitionCN: 从一个角连到另一个角的

entries.definition: to recognize what something is
to find out something exactly
to notice something hidden

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a film held up to a lamp and end with a report naming a company's weakness.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从举到灯前的片子开始，落到一份点出公司弱点的报告。

normal.en: Dia- means through, and knowing through a thing is diagnosis.
normal.cn: dia- 是穿过，把一件事看穿到底，就是诊断。

normal.en: The doctor does not guess; the doctor separates one cause from many.
normal.cn: 医生不猜，医生是从许多原因里把那个挑出来。

normal.en: An engine and a patient both answer only through signs.
normal.cn: 发动机与病人，都只通过迹象回答。

normal.en: A fault named is already half repaired.
normal.cn: 故障一旦被叫出名字，就已经修好了一半。

normal.en: The same word can read a body, a car or a company.
normal.cn: 同一个词，能读身体，也能读汽车与公司。

abstract.en: Picture a dark film glowing on a light box.
abstract.cn: 想象一张暗色片子在看片灯上发亮。

abstract.en: Picture a pen point resting on one grey shadow.
abstract.cn: 想象笔尖停在某一团灰色阴影上。

abstract.en: Picture a list of causes with one line underlined.
abstract.cn: 想象一张原因清单，其中一行被划了线。

examples.en: The doctor diagnosed the illness as a rare infection.
examples.cn: 医生诊断这种病是一种罕见的感染。

examples.en: Engineers diagnosed the fault in less than an hour.
examples.cn: 工程师不到一小时就判断出了故障所在。

examples.en: The report diagnosed the company's weakness as poor planning.
examples.cn: 报告判定这家公司的弱点是计划不周。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 diagnose 记成「带个脑子」：dia 是穿过，gnose 是知道，把病情看穿、知道了，就是诊断。

root: 来自希腊语 diagignoskein，由 dia-（穿过、彻底）与 gignoskein（知道）组成，本义是把一种病与另一种病分辨清楚。经医学拉丁语进入英语，先有名词 diagnosis，再由它反推造出动词 diagnose，后来也用于判断机器、组织与制度的问题。

sensesIntro.en: From naming a disease, to tracing a fault in a machine, to judging what is wrong with an organisation.
sensesIntro.cn: 从给一种病命名，到追出机器里的故障，再到判断一个组织哪里出了毛病。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a shadow on a lit film that a pen point singles out.
core.cn: 核心意象：亮着的片子上有一团阴影，笔尖把它单独指出来。

branches.en: The first sense is a name given to a body's trouble.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是给身体的麻烦安上名字。

branches.en: The second sense is the same reading done on a machine.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是把同样的读法用在机器上。

branches.en: The third sense is that reading widened to a whole group of people.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是把这种读法扩大到一群人身上。

branches.en: A patient and an engine both speak through symptoms.
branches.cn: 病人与发动机，都通过症状说话。

branches.en: A broken machine and a badly run company fail in patterns.
branches.cn: 坏掉的机器与经营不善的公司，都以某种模式出问题。

intro.en: Diagnose has a family built on knowing through and telling apart.
intro.cn: diagnose 有一族词，建在「看穿」与「分辨」之上。

latinIntro.en: The Greek base gignoskein means to know, and dia- adds the sense of seeing through.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊词基 gignoskein 意为知道，前缀 dia- 添上看穿的意思。

items.meaning: to identify an illness or fault

items.exampleCN: 他们做了一次诊断测试。
她是去年春天被诊断出来的。

items.example: He diagnoses ten cases a day.

items.exampleCN: 诊断专家查看了扫描片。

definition_en: a simple drawing that shows the parts of something or how it works
core_image: 黑板上几个方框和箭头，把机器的内部讲清楚
scene: 老师在黑板上画了几个方框和箭头，把水流的方向标出来。The diagram shows how water moves through the plant.
sceneCN: 这里 diagram 指「示意图」（第 1 个义项：用简单线条说明结构的图）；句意是这张示意图显示水如何在植物中流动。

senses.title: A simple explanatory drawing
senses.definition: a simple drawing that shows the parts of something and how they fit
senses.definitionCN: 用简单线条画出某物的各部分及其组合关系
senses.example: The diagram shows how water moves through the plant.
senses.exampleCN: 这张示意图显示水如何在植物中流动。
senses.why: A picture of the parts removes the need for a hundred words.
senses.whyCN: 一张画清零件的图，省掉了一百句话。

senses.title: A chart of steps or numbers
senses.definition: a drawing that sets out numbers, steps or relations in visual form
senses.definitionCN: 把数字、步骤或关系用视觉形式摆出来的图
senses.example: The diagram on page ten compares the two methods.
senses.exampleCN: 第十页上的图表比较了这两种方法。
senses.why: Once the steps are drawn, the eye can walk them.
senses.whyCN: 步骤一旦被画出来，眼睛就能在上面走。

senses.title: Show something by drawing
senses.definition: to represent something with a simple drawing
senses.definitionCN: 用简单的图把某事物表示出来
senses.example: He diagrammed the route on the back of an envelope.
senses.exampleCN: 他在信封背面把路线画了出来。
senses.why: When speech fails, the hand reaches for a pen.
senses.whyCN: 说不清的时候，手就去拿笔。

intro.en: Diagram comes from Greek diagramma, something marked out by lines, built from dia- and graphein, to write or draw.
intro.cn: diagram 来自希腊语 diagramma（用线标出来的东西），由 dia- 与 graphein（写、画）构成。

items.en: Graphein meant to scratch or draw, and diagramma meant a figure marked out.
items.cn: graphein 指刻画，diagramma 指被线条标出的图形。

items.en: Geometers used it for the figure drawn beside a proof.
items.cn: 几何学家用它指证明旁边画出的那个图形。

items.en: Latin diagramma kept the mathematical sense of a drawn figure.
items.cn: 拉丁语 diagramma 保留了画出图形的数学义。

items.en: English diagram named a figure used to explain a text.
items.cn: 英语 diagram 指用来解释文字的图形。

items.en: It now covers circuit plans, flow charts and simple sketches.
items.cn: 如今它覆盖电路图、流程图以及简单草图。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the dia- opening, while the meaning group names other visual aids.
note.cn: 形近组共用 dia- 开头，近义组则指其他几种视觉工具。

entries.definition: to identify an illness or fault
a line across a circle through its centre
entries.definitionCN: 穿过圆心横跨圆的一条线

entries.definition: a form of a language spoken in one area
entries.definitionCN: 某一地区所说的一种语言形式

entries.definition: a drawing that shows information
a drawing of values on axes
entries.definitionCN: 在坐标轴上画出数值的图

entries.definition: a quick rough drawing

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with chalk boxes on a blackboard and end with a route drawn on an envelope.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从黑板上的粉笔方框开始，落到画在信封上的路线。

normal.en: Dia- is through, and a diagram draws a line through a complicated thing.
normal.cn: dia- 是穿过，diagram 就是在一个复杂东西上画穿一条线。

normal.en: Boxes and arrows are a sentence the eye can read at once.
normal.cn: 方框与箭头，是一句眼睛一眼就能读完的话。

normal.en: A good diagram leaves out more than it shows.
normal.cn: 好的示意图，省掉的东西比画出来的多。

normal.en: The circuit and the river use the same little arrows.
normal.cn: 电路与河流，用的是同样的小箭头。

normal.en: When words get heavy, draw the shape.
normal.cn: 话变重的时候，就把形状画出来。

abstract.en: Picture three chalk squares joined by one line.
abstract.cn: 想象三个粉笔方框被一条线连起来。

abstract.en: Picture an arrow pointing down a narrow pipe.
abstract.cn: 想象一个箭头沿着一根细管向下指。

abstract.en: Picture a pen making a quick turn on paper.
abstract.cn: 想象一支笔在纸上快速拐了个弯。

examples.en: The diagram shows how water moves through the plant.
examples.cn: 这张示意图显示水如何在植物中流动。

examples.en: The diagram on page ten compares the two methods.
examples.cn: 第十页上的图表比较了这两种方法。

examples.en: He diagrammed the route on the back of an envelope.
examples.cn: 他在信封背面把路线画了出来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 diagram 记成「带个弯」：dia 是穿过，gram 是写下的东西，用线穿过复杂处写下来，就是示意图。

root: 来自希腊语 diagramma，由 dia-（穿过）与 graphein（刻画）组成，本义是用线标出的图形。经拉丁语进入英语，最初用于几何证明旁画的图，后来泛指解释结构、步骤与数据的各种图示。

sensesIntro.en: From a figure drawn beside a proof, to a chart of steps, to a quick sketch on an envelope.
sensesIntro.cn: 从证明旁边画出的图形，到步骤图表，再到信封上的快速草图。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a few boxes and arrows explaining a hidden mechanism.
core.cn: 核心意象：几个方框和箭头，把藏在里面的机关讲明白。

branches.en: The first sense is the parts laid out in space.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是把各部分在空间里摆开。

branches.en: The second sense puts steps and numbers in place of parts.
branches.cn: 第二个义项用步骤和数字替换了零件。

branches.en: The third sense is the act of drawing it at all.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是把它画出来这个动作本身。

branches.en: A machine and a set of figures are both made readable by lines.
branches.cn: 机器与一串数字，都靠线条变得可读。

branches.en: The chart and the quick sketch differ only in care.
branches.cn: 图表与速写，只差在精细程度。

intro.en: Diagram has a family built on drawing and on lines that mark a shape.
intro.cn: diagram 有一族词，建在「画」与「用线标出形状」之上。

latinIntro.en: The Greek base graphein means to draw or write, and dia- adds the sense of marking across.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊词基 graphein 意为画或写，前缀 dia- 添上横着标出的意思。

items.example: The diagram is easy to follow.
items.exampleCN: 这张示意图很容易看懂。
这本书有清楚的示意图。

items.meaning: the act of drawing a figure
items.example: Diagramming the flow took an hour.
items.exampleCN: 把流程画成图花了一小时。

items.meaning: in the form of a diagram
items.exampleCN: 这份平面图只是示意性的。
这些部件以图解方式呈现。
绘图的人用了三种颜色。

definition_en: a form of a language spoken in one area or by one group of people
core_image: 同一条街两头的人，用不同腔调说同一个词
scene: 集市上卖菜的老人把「土豆」说成另一个音，年轻人听不太懂。The dialect spoken in the valley has its own words for rain.
sceneCN: 这里 dialect 指「方言」（第 1 个义项：某一地区通行的语言变体）；句意是山谷里说的方言有自己一套表示雨的词。

senses.title: A regional form of a language
senses.definition: a form of a language spoken in one particular area
senses.definitionCN: 在某一特定地区通行的一种语言形式
senses.example: The dialect spoken in the valley has its own words for rain.
senses.exampleCN: 山谷里说的方言有自己一套表示雨的词。
senses.why: Every valley keeps its own small vocabulary for weather.
senses.whyCN: 每个山谷都为天气留着自己的一小套词。

senses.title: A group's way of speaking
senses.definition: the speech of a social group or trade rather than a whole region
senses.definitionCN: 某一社会群体或行业而非整个地区所说的语言
senses.example: The dock workers had a dialect full of sea words.
senses.exampleCN: 码头工人有一种满是海上词汇的土语。
senses.why: A trade grows its own words the way a garden grows its own weeds.
senses.whyCN: 一个行业长出自己的词，就像园子长出自己的草。

senses.title: A particular style of speech
senses.definition: a special way of speaking used by a group or in a piece of writing
senses.definitionCN: 某个群体或某篇作品里使用的特别说法
senses.example: The poem is written in the dialect of the streets.
senses.exampleCN: 这首诗用的是街头那套用语。
senses.why: A style of speech is a costume a text can wear.
senses.whyCN: 一种说话方式，是文字可以穿上的戏服。

intro.en: Dialect comes from Greek dialektos, a conversation or the speech of a region, from dialegesthai, to talk with someone.
intro.cn: dialect 来自希腊语 dialektos（交谈、某地区的说话方式），源自动词 dialegesthai（与人交谈）。

items.en: Dialegesthai meant to talk something through with another person.
items.cn: dialegesthai 指与另一个人把话说透。

items.en: Dialektos named the speech of a particular place or group.
items.cn: dialektos 指某个地方或群体特有的说话方式。

items.en: Latin dialectus kept the sense of a local form of Greek.
items.cn: 拉丁语 dialectus 保留了「希腊语的地方变体」这一意思。

items.en: English dialect was used for regional forms of any language.
items.cn: 英语 dialect 用来指任何语言的地方变体。

items.en: Linguists now treat dialects as full systems, not errors.
items.cn: 如今语言学家把方言看作完整系统，而不是错误。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the dia- opening, and the meaning group names accents, local speech and languages.
note.cn: 形近组共用 dia- 开头，近义组则指口音、本地话与语言。

entries.definition: belonging to a local form of speech
a conversation between people
reasoning through opposing ideas
entries.definitionCN: 通过对立观点推进的推理

entries.definition: the way a group pronounces words
entries.definitionCN: 一群人说词的发音方式

entries.definition: the everyday speech of ordinary people
a system of words used by a people
entries.definitionCN: 一个民族使用的词语系统

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with two accents on one street and end with a poem wearing the speech of the street.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从同一条街上的两种腔调开始，落到一首穿着街头用语的诗。

normal.en: Dialect began as the word for conversation, not for error.
normal.cn: dialect 最初是「交谈」的意思，并不是「错误」。

normal.en: A valley can put its own name on the rain.
normal.cn: 一个山谷，能给雨起自己的名字。

normal.en: Every trade carries a small dictionary in its pocket.
normal.cn: 每个行业的口袋里都装着一本小词典。

normal.en: An accent is how it sounds; a dialect is what it says.
normal.cn: 口音是听起来怎样，方言是说了些什么。

normal.en: Two villages, one language, and a fence of words between them.
normal.cn: 两个村子，一种语言，中间隔着一道词的篱笆。

abstract.en: Picture two old men saying one word differently.
abstract.cn: 想象两位老人把同一个词说成两个样。

abstract.en: Picture a market stall with a hand-written sign.
abstract.cn: 想象一个摊位上挂着块手写的牌子。

abstract.en: Picture a poem printed with odd spellings.
abstract.cn: 想象一首诗，印着些奇怪的拼法。

examples.en: The dialect spoken in the valley has its own words for rain.
examples.cn: 山谷里说的方言有自己一套表示雨的词。

examples.en: The dock workers had a dialect full of sea words.
examples.cn: 码头工人有一种满是海上词汇的土语。

examples.en: The poem is written in the dialect of the streets.
examples.cn: 这首诗用的是街头那套用语。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 dialect 记成「带个来客」：dia 是穿过，lect 是说，一个地方的人穿过来说的话，就是方言。

root: 来自希腊语 dialektos，源自动词 dialegesthai（交谈），本义是与人把话说透。经拉丁语进入英语后，专指某一地区或群体所说的语言变体，现代语言学把它看作完整系统而非错误说法。

sensesIntro.en: From the speech of one valley, to the private words of a trade, to a style a poem can wear.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一个山谷的说话方式，到一个行业的私房词，再到一首诗能穿上的腔调。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one word pronounced two ways at the two ends of a street.
core.cn: 核心意象：同一个词，在一条街的两头有两种读法。

branches.en: The first sense is the speech of one piece of land.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是一片土地上的人说的话。

branches.en: The second sense follows a trade instead of a place.
branches.cn: 第二个义项跟着一个行业走，而不是跟着地方走。

branches.en: The third sense is that speech borrowed into writing.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是那种话被借进了文字里。

branches.en: A region and a workshop both keep their own small vocabulary.
branches.cn: 一个地区与一个作坊，都守着自己的一小套词。

branches.en: A way of speaking can become a style on the page.
branches.cn: 一种说话方式，能变成纸面上的一种风格。

intro.en: Dialect has a family built on conversation and on the study of local speech.
intro.cn: dialect 有一族词，建在交谈与对地方话的研究上。

latinIntro.en: The Greek base means to talk something through, and the family grew around regional speech.
latinIntro.cn: 它的希腊词基意为把事情谈透，这一族词围绕地方话生长。

items.example: This dialect is hard to follow.

items.exampleCN: 这两种形式在方言上不同。
这位方言学家把边界标在地图上。

items.example: The text was dialectalized on purpose.
items.exampleCN: 这段文字被有意加上了方言色彩。
这场争论沿着一种辩证方式推进。

definition_en: a straight line across a circle through its centre, or the length of that line
core_image: 一根细线从圆的一边穿过圆心拉到另一边
scene: 木匠把圆桌翻过来，用卷尺从一边量到另一边，尺子正好过中心。The diameter of the table is one metre.
sceneCN: 这里 diameter 指「直径」（第 1 个义项：穿过圆心、两端落在圆上的线段）；句意是这张桌子的直径是一米。

senses.title: A line across a circle
senses.definition: a straight line that passes through the centre of a circle and touches both sides
senses.definitionCN: 穿过圆心、两端都落在圆上的直线
senses.example: The diameter of the table is one metre.
senses.exampleCN: 这张桌子的直径是一米。
senses.why: The longest straight path through a round thing must pass its centre.
senses.whyCN: 穿过一个圆东西的最长直线，必然经过它的中心。

senses.title: The length measured that way
senses.definition: the length of such a line, used as a measure of how wide a round thing is
senses.definitionCN: 这条线的长度，用来衡量圆形物体有多宽
senses.example: The circle has a diameter of ten centimetres.
senses.exampleCN: 这个圆的直径是十厘米。
senses.why: One number can stand for the whole width of a circle.
senses.whyCN: 一个数字，就能代表一个圆整个的宽度。

senses.title: The width of a round opening
senses.definition: the width of a tube, pipe or opening measured across its centre
senses.definitionCN: 管子、管道或开口穿过中心量出的宽度
senses.example: The pipe has an internal diameter of ten centimetres.
senses.exampleCN: 这根管子的内径是十厘米。
senses.why: A pipe is only a circle pulled out into length.
senses.whyCN: 一根管子，不过是把圆拉成了长度。

intro.en: Diameter comes from Greek diametros, a measuring across, built from dia-, across, and metron, a measure.
intro.cn: diameter 来自希腊语 diametros（横量过去），由 dia-（横穿）与 metron（量度）构成。

items.en: Metron meant a measure or a unit of length.
items.cn: metron 指量度或长度单位。

items.en: Diametros meant the measure taken straight across a circle.
items.cn: diametros 指横穿一个圆量出的长度。

items.en: Latin diametrus brought the word into geometry books.
items.cn: 拉丁语 diametrus 把这个词带进了几何书。

items.en: English diameter named the line through the centre.
items.cn: 英语 diameter 指穿过中心的那条线。

items.en: It now also measures pipes, lenses and other round openings.
items.cn: 如今它也用来量管子、镜片以及其他圆形开口。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the dia- opening, while the meaning group names other measurements of width.
note.cn: 形近组共用 dia- 开头，近义组则指其他几种宽度的量度。

entries.definition: a simple explanatory drawing
a regional form of a language
relating to a line across a circle
the distance from one side to the other
entries.definitionCN: 从一边到另一边的距离

entries.definition: the measure of how wide something is
the line around the edge of a circle

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a tape pulled across a round table and end with a pipe measured from inside.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从拉过圆桌的卷尺开始，落到从里面量的一根管子。

normal.en: Dia- is across, and metron is measure, so a diameter is a measure straight across.
normal.cn: dia- 是横穿，metron 是量，所以直径就是横着量过去。

normal.en: The longest line in a circle has to go through its middle.
normal.cn: 圆里最长的那条线，必须穿过中间。

normal.en: Half the diameter is the radius, the shorter walk home.
normal.cn: 直径的一半是半径，是更短的那段路。

normal.en: A pipe is a circle stretched until it holds water.
normal.cn: 管子就是一个被拉长到能装水的圆。

normal.en: One number can describe a whole round rim.
normal.cn: 一个数字，就能描述整个圆边。

abstract.en: Picture a tape measure lying across a wooden table.
abstract.cn: 想象一把卷尺横放在木桌上。

abstract.en: Picture a chalk dot in the middle of a circle.
abstract.cn: 想象圆圈正中有一个粉笔点。

abstract.en: Picture a coin standing on its edge.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚硬币立在自己的边上。

examples.en: The diameter of the table is one metre.
examples.cn: 这张桌子的直径是一米。

examples.en: The circle has a diameter of ten centimetres.
examples.cn: 这个圆的直径是十厘米。

examples.en: The pipe has an internal diameter of ten centimetres.
examples.cn: 这根管子的内径是十厘米。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 diameter 记成「带个米特」：dia 是横穿，meter 是量，横着穿过圆心量一量，就是直径。

root: 来自希腊语 diametros，由 dia-（横穿）与 metron（量度）组成，本义是横穿圆量出的长度。经拉丁语进入几何学，后来除表示穿过圆心的线段与长度外，也用于表示管子、镜片等圆形开口的口径。

sensesIntro.en: From the longest line in a circle, to the number that reports it, to the inside width of a pipe.
sensesIntro.cn: 从圆里最长的那条线，到报出这个长度的数字，再到一根管子的内宽。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a fine line crossing a circle exactly through its centre.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根细线正好穿过圆心横跨一个圆。

branches.en: The first sense is the line itself, drawn through the middle.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是那条穿过中间的线本身。

branches.en: The second sense is the number that line gives.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是那条线给出的数字。

branches.en: The third sense is the same number read inside a tube.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是同一个数字在管子里被读出来。

branches.en: A line and a length are one fact told two ways.
branches.cn: 线与长度，是同一件事的两种说法。

branches.en: A tabletop and a pipe are both measured across their middle.
branches.cn: 桌面与管子，都是穿过中间去量。

intro.en: Diameter has a small family built on measuring across a round shape.
intro.cn: diameter 有一小族词，建在「横穿圆形去量」之上。

latinIntro.en: The base metron means measure, and dia- tells you the measuring goes across.
latinIntro.cn: 词基 metron 意为量度，前缀 dia- 说明这次量是横穿过去的。

items.example: The diameter is easy to check.
The two pipes have equal diameters.
items.exampleCN: 这两根管子的直径相等。

items.example: The points lie in diametric positions.
items.exampleCN: 这两个点处在直径的两端。

items.meaning: balance on two sides of a line

definition_en: a very hard clear precious stone, or a shape with four equal sides
core_image: 黑绒布上放着一颗石头，灯一照，四面都射出细光
scene: 珠宝店的柜台上铺着黑绒，一颗石头被灯照着，四面都在闪。The diamond on the ring caught the light.
sceneCN: 这里 diamond 指「钻石」（第 1 个义项：一种极硬而透明的宝石）；句意是戒指上那颗钻石接住了灯光。

collocations.zh: 未经琢磨的钻石；外粗内秀的人

senses.title: A hard clear gem
senses.definition: a very hard clear precious stone used in jewellery
senses.definitionCN: 一种极硬而透明的贵重宝石，用于首饰
senses.example: The diamond on the ring caught the light.
senses.exampleCN: 戒指上那颗钻石接住了灯光。
senses.why: The hardest thing in the room is also the one that breaks light into pieces.
senses.whyCN: 屋里最硬的东西，也最会把光拆成碎片。

senses.title: A four-sided shape
senses.definition: a shape with four equal straight sides and two pairs of equal angles
senses.definitionCN: 四边相等、两对角分别相等的一种图形
senses.example: The tiles were laid in a diamond pattern.
senses.exampleCN: 瓷砖被铺成菱形图案。
senses.why: A square tipped onto one corner looks like a cut gem.
senses.whyCN: 一个方框用角立起来，就像一颗切好的宝石。

senses.title: The card suit
senses.definition: one of the four suits in a pack of cards, marked with a red diamond
senses.definitionCN: 一副纸牌中四种花色之一，以红色菱形为标记
senses.example: He played the ace of diamonds and won the trick.
senses.exampleCN: 他打出方块 A，赢了这一墩。
senses.why: A gem can become a small red mark on a card.
senses.whyCN: 一颗宝石，能变成纸牌上的一个小红记号。

intro.en: Diamond comes from Greek adamas, the unconquerable, through Latin and Old French, and it has always named the hardest stone.
intro.cn: diamond 来自希腊语 adamas（不可征服的），经拉丁语与古法语进入英语，一直指最硬的石头。

items.en: Adamas meant unconquerable, built from a- and daman, to tame.
items.cn: adamas 意为不可征服，由 a-（不）与 daman（驯服）构成。

items.en: The stone was named for its refusal to be cut or worn down.
items.cn: 这种石头因不肯被切开、被磨损而得名。

items.en: Latin adamas shifted toward the form diamans.
items.cn: 拉丁语 adamas 渐渐变成 diamans 这一形式。

items.en: French diamant gave English its spelling and its jewellery sense.
items.cn: 法语 diamant 给了英语拼写，也给了首饰这层意思。

items.en: The shape and the card suit borrowed the same pointed figure.
items.cn: 菱形与纸牌方块借用了同一个带尖角的图形。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the diamond stem, while the meaning group names other precious stones.
note.cn: 形近组共用 diamond 这个词干，近义组则指其他几种贵重石头。

entries.definition: a snake with diamond markings
hard and bright like a diamond
decorated with small sparkling stones
a cut stone of high value
a precious stone set in metal
clear mineral with a regular shape
entries.definitionCN: 形状规则而透明的矿物

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a stone on black cloth and end with a red mark on a playing card.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从黑布上的一颗石头开始，落到纸牌上的一个红记号。

normal.en: The Greek name meant unconquerable, and the stone still refuses the knife.
normal.cn: 那个希腊名字意为不可征服，这颗石头至今也不肯让刀。

normal.en: Diamond is a shape as well as a stone: a square standing on one toe.
normal.cn: diamond 既是石头也是形状：一个踮着一只脚的方框。

normal.en: The card suit keeps the gem as a small red rhombus.
normal.cn: 纸牌花色把那颗宝石留成了一个小小的红菱形。

normal.en: Hard things also make the best windows for light.
normal.cn: 坚硬的东西，也最会给光开窗。

normal.en: A rough diamond is a person worth cutting.
normal.cn: 未经琢磨的钻石，说的是一个值得打磨的人。

abstract.en: Picture a stone with many flat faces.
abstract.cn: 想象一颗有许多平面的石头。

abstract.en: Picture a ring held up against a lamp.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚戒指被举到灯前。

abstract.en: Picture four white bases in dry grass.
abstract.cn: 想象干草地上四个白色的垒包。

examples.en: The diamond on the ring caught the light.
examples.cn: 戒指上那颗钻石接住了灯光。

examples.en: The tiles were laid in a diamond pattern.
examples.cn: 瓷砖被铺成菱形图案。

examples.en: He played the ace of diamonds and won the trick.
examples.cn: 他打出方块 A，赢了这一墩。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 diamond 记成「带个蒙的」：dia 是穿过，mond 像「芒」，光穿过石头射出光芒，那就是钻石。

root: 来自希腊语 adamas（不可征服），经拉丁语与古法语 diamant 进入英语。本义是坚硬到不肯被切割的宝石，后来也指被切成菱形的东西，并用于纸牌的方块花色与棒球场的内场。

sensesIntro.en: From the hardest stone, to the shape of a cut gem, to a small red mark on a card.
sensesIntro.cn: 从最硬的石头，到切好宝石的形状，再到纸牌上的一个小红记号。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a clear stone with many flat faces throwing light in all directions.
core.cn: 核心意象：一颗有许多切面的透明石头，把光射向四面八方。

branches.en: The first sense is the stone itself and its value.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是石头本身以及它的价值。

branches.en: The second sense is the outline of the cut stone.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是切好的石头的外轮廓。

branches.en: The third sense is that outline reduced to a card symbol.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是那个轮廓缩小成纸牌符号。

branches.en: The gem and the rhombus share one pointed figure.
branches.cn: 宝石与菱形，共用同一个带尖的形状。

branches.en: A floor pattern and a card suit both repeat a small diamond.
branches.cn: 地面图案与纸牌花色，都在重复一个小菱形。

intro.en: Diamond has a small family built on hardness, brightness and the pointed shape.
intro.cn: diamond 有一小族词，建在坚硬、明亮与尖角形状上。

latinIntro.en: The Greek base means unconquerable, and the family keeps that sense of something that will not yield.
latinIntro.cn: 它的希腊词基意为不可征服，这一族词保留着「不肯屈服」的意思。

items.meaning: more than one gem, or the card suit
items.example: She wore diamonds at the dinner.
The surface has a diamantine shine.
items.exampleCN: 这个表面有钻石般的光泽。
一条菱背蛇穿过了小路。
这层膜是类金刚石结构。
他们发现了含钻石的岩石。

definition_en: a book in which you write what happens to you each day
core_image: 床头一本带小锁的本子，页边已经磨毛
scene: 女孩把本子塞到枕头下，小钥匙还挂在细绳上。She wrote three lines in her diary before sleeping.
sceneCN: 这里 diary 指「日记本」（第 1 个义项：每天记事情的本子）；句意是她睡前在日记本上写了三行。

senses.title: A book of daily records
senses.definition: a book in which you write what happens to you each day
senses.definitionCN: 每天把发生在自己身上的事写进去的本子
senses.example: She wrote three lines in her diary before sleeping.
senses.exampleCN: 她睡前在日记本上写了三行。
senses.why: A day is too large to keep, so a page is cut from it.
senses.whyCN: 一整天太大拿不住，就从上面裁下一页。

senses.title: The record itself
senses.definition: the daily record kept in such a book
senses.definitionCN: 记在这种本子里的逐日记录
senses.example: His diary of the voyage was published later.
senses.exampleCN: 他这次航行的日记后来出版了。
senses.why: The book can outlive the days it describes.
senses.whyCN: 本子能比它记下的那些日子活得更久。

senses.title: An appointment book
senses.definition: a book used to note appointments and dates
senses.definitionCN: 用来记约会与日期的本子
senses.example: The meeting is in my diary for Friday.
senses.exampleCN: 会议记在我周五的日程簿上。
senses.why: The same page holds what happened and what will happen.
senses.whyCN: 同一页上，既装已经发生的事，也装将要发生的事。

intro.en: Diary comes from Latin diarium, a daily allowance or daily record, from dies, a day, and entered English in the sixteenth century.
intro.cn: diary 来自拉丁语 diarium（每日的口粮或逐日记录），源词 dies 意为一天，十六世纪进入英语。

items.en: Dies meant a day, and diarium meant a daily portion.
items.cn: dies 指一天，diarium 指每日的一份。

items.en: Soldiers received a diarium, a daily allowance of money or food.
items.cn: 士兵领一份 diarium，即每日的钱或口粮。

items.en: The word also named a book that set down events day by day.
items.cn: 这个词也指逐日记下事情的册子。

items.en: English diary meant a daily record of a person's own life.
items.cn: 英语 diary 指一个人自己生活的逐日记录。

items.en: It now also means a book for appointments and dates.
items.cn: 如今它也指记约会与日期的本子。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -ary ending, while the meaning group names other books of record.
note.cn: 形近组共用 -ary 这一结尾，近义组则指其他几种记录本。

entries.definition: a place where milk is kept or sold
entries.definitionCN: 存放或出售牛奶的地方

entries.definition: a round face with numbers or marks
a person who keeps a diary
a book of daily thoughts or events
entries.definitionCN: 记录每日想法或事情的本子

entries.definition: an official record of events
a small book for writing notes

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a locked book under a pillow and end with a date circled on a desk pad.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从枕头下带锁的本子开始，落到桌垫上被圈起来的日期。

normal.en: Diary and dairy differ by one swapped letter and one whole world.
normal.cn: diary 与 dairy 只差一个字母，却是两个世界。

normal.en: Dies is a day, so a diary is a stack of days in paper form.
normal.cn: dies 是一天，所以日记本就是一叠纸做的日子。

normal.en: A diary keeps what the mouth was afraid to say.
normal.cn: 日记收着嘴巴不敢说的话。

normal.en: The same book remembers the past and warns about Friday.
normal.cn: 同一个本子，既记住过去，也提醒周五。

normal.en: Three lines a night becomes a life in one shelf.
normal.cn: 每晚三行，最后能装成一整架人生。

abstract.en: Picture a tiny key on a red string.
abstract.cn: 想象一根红绳上挂着小钥匙。

abstract.en: Picture a page ruled with faint blue lines.
abstract.cn: 想象一页印着淡蓝横线的纸。

abstract.en: Picture one square circled twice in pencil.
abstract.cn: 想象一个小方框被铅笔圈了两遍。

examples.en: She wrote three lines in her diary before sleeping.
examples.cn: 她睡前在日记本上写了三行。

examples.en: His diary of the voyage was published later.
examples.cn: 他这次航行的日记后来出版了。

examples.en: The meeting is in my diary for Friday.
examples.cn: 会议记在我周五的日程簿上。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 diary 记成「带日记」：di 是日，ary 是本子，逐日写下的本子就是日记本。

root: 来自拉丁语 diarium，源词 dies 意为一天。本义是每日配给的口粮或钱，也指逐日记事的册子。十六世纪进入英语后专指记录个人日常生活的本子，后来也用来指记约会与日期的日程簿。

sensesIntro.en: From a page cut out of one day, to the record that outlives it, to a date waiting in the future.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一天里裁下的一页，到比那些日子活得更久的记录，再到一个等着你的未来日期。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small locked book with worn edges beside a bed.
core.cn: 核心意象：床头一本带锁、边角磨毛的小本子。

branches.en: The first sense is the book that receives the day.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是接住这一天的本子。

branches.en: The second sense is the record after many days.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是许多天之后留下的记录。

branches.en: The third sense turns the same page toward the future.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把同一页转向未来。

branches.en: The book and its contents are one object seen at two times.
branches.cn: 本子与它的内容，是同一件东西在两个时刻的样子。

branches.en: A record of the past and a plan for Friday share one cover.
branches.cn: 过去的记录与周五的计划，共用一个封面。

intro.en: Diary has a small family built on days and on the habit of writing them down.
intro.cn: diary 有一小族词，建在「日子」与「把日子写下来」这个习惯上。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base dies means day, and the family keeps that daily beat.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词基 dies 意为一天，这一族词都保持着这种逐日的节奏。

items.example: The diary has a red cover.

items.meaning: a person who keeps a diary
items.exampleCN: 这位记日记的人每晚都写。

items.meaning: in the style of a diary

items.exampleCN: 这些笔记带有日记性质。

definition_en: to say words for someone to write down, or to order something firmly
core_image: 一个人在屋里边走边说，旁边的人低头飞快记录
scene: 老编辑在屋里来回走，一句一句念，年轻助手埋头记。The manager dictated a short letter to his assistant.
sceneCN: 这里 dictate 指「口述」（第 1 个义项：念出文字让人记下来）；句意是经理向助手口述了一封短信。

senses.title: Say words to be written
senses.definition: to speak words aloud so that someone else can write them down
senses.definitionCN: 把话念出来，让别人记录下来
senses.example: The manager dictated a short letter to his assistant.
senses.exampleCN: 经理向助手口述了一封短信。
senses.why: One mouth can keep moving while another hand does the slow work.
senses.whyCN: 一张嘴可以一直说，另一只手去做那件慢活。

senses.title: Order with authority
senses.definition: to tell someone what to do in a forceful and official way
senses.definitionCN: 以强硬而正式的方式吩咐别人做什么
senses.example: The general dictated the terms of the surrender.
senses.exampleCN: 将军规定了投降的条件。
senses.why: When the words carry power, the listener has no pen to refuse with.
senses.whyCN: 当话里带着权力，听的人就没有一支可以拒绝的笔。

senses.title: Control or decide
senses.definition: to control or decide what happens
senses.definitionCN: 控制或决定事情会怎么发生
senses.example: Demand often dictates what a factory produces.
senses.exampleCN: 需求常常决定工厂生产什么。
senses.why: An invisible force can still write the script everyone follows.
senses.whyCN: 看不见的力量，也能写下所有人照着念的剧本。

intro.en: Dictate comes from Latin dictare, to say repeatedly or to prescribe, a stronger form of dicere, to say.
intro.cn: dictate 来自拉丁语 dictare（反复说、规定），是 dicere（说）的加强形式。

items.en: Dicere meant simply to say or to tell.
items.cn: dicere 就是「说」或「告诉」。

items.en: Dictare meant to say again and again, so that others could take it down.
items.cn: dictare 指一遍遍地说，好让别人记下来。

items.en: It also meant to order, because a repeated word carries authority.
items.cn: 它也指命令，因为反复说出的话自带权威。

items.en: English dictate kept both the writing and the ordering senses.
items.cn: 英语 dictate 同时保留了记录与命令这两层意思。

items.en: It now also describes forces, needs and circumstances that decide things.
items.cn: 如今它也形容决定事情的力量、需求与形势。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the dict stem, while the meaning group moves from commanding to prescribing and instructing.
note.cn: 形近组共用 dict 这个词干，近义组则从命令走到规定与指示。

entries.definition: the act of speaking words to be written
entries.definitionCN: 念出文字让人记录的行为

entries.definition: a ruler with total power
entries.definitionCN: 掌握全部权力的统治者

entries.definition: a book listing words and meanings
to order someone to do something
to state what must be done
to tell someone how to do something

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a voice walking around a room and end with a market deciding what a factory makes.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从在屋里走来走去的声音开始，落到决定工厂生产什么的市场。

normal.en: Dictare is to say it again, so the other hand has time to catch up.
normal.cn: dictare 就是再说一遍，好让另一只手跟得上。

normal.en: The same verb gives order to a clerk and orders to an army.
normal.cn: 同一个动词，既给职员派活，也给军队下令。

normal.en: A letter can be dictated; a price can be dictated; both come from above.
normal.cn: 信可以被口述，价格可以被规定，两者都来自上方。

normal.en: Demand holds the pen even when nobody is in the room.
normal.cn: 即使屋里没人，需求也握着那支笔。

normal.en: A dictator is simply a voice that stopped listening.
normal.cn: 独裁者不过是一个不再听的嗓音。

abstract.en: Picture a man pacing beside a window.
abstract.cn: 想象一个男人在窗边来回踱步。

abstract.en: Picture a pen moving without looking up.
abstract.cn: 想象一支笔头也不抬地移动。

abstract.en: Picture a long table where terms are read aloud.
abstract.cn: 想象一张长桌，条件被逐条念出来。

examples.en: The manager dictated a short letter to his assistant.
examples.cn: 经理向助手口述了一封短信。

examples.en: The general dictated the terms of the surrender.
examples.cn: 将军规定了投降的条件。

examples.en: Demand often dictates what a factory produces.
examples.cn: 需求常常决定工厂生产什么。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 dictate 记成「迪克推特」：dict 是说，-ate 是动词，把话推出去说给人记，就是口述与命令。

root: 来自拉丁语 dictare，是 dicere（说）的加强形式，本义是一遍遍地说，好让别人记下来，也指以权威口气规定。十六世纪进入英语，既保留口述义，也发展出命令与支配义。

sensesIntro.en: From a voice slowly feeding a pen, to a voice that expects obedience, to an unseen force writing the rules.
sensesIntro.cn: 从慢慢喂给笔的一把声音，到期待服从的一把声音，再到写下规则的看不见的力量。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a voice pacing the room while a hand hurries to keep up.
core.cn: 核心意象：一把声音在屋里踱步，一只手忙着跟上。

branches.en: The first sense is the voice serving the writer.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是声音在为记录者服务。

branches.en: The second sense is the voice that no longer asks.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是那把不再询问的声音。

branches.en: The third sense is a force that writes without a mouth.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是没有嘴却在写字的某种力量。

branches.en: The same steady speech can serve or command.
branches.cn: 同一种平稳的说话，可以服务，也可以命令。

intro.en: Dictate has a family built on saying, repeating and laying down the law.

latinIntro.cn: 词基是拉丁语 dicere（说），dictare 则带着权威把它反复说出。

definition_en: the act of saying words for someone to write down, or a test in which you write what is read
core_image: 教室里笔尖沙沙响，老师一句句慢慢念
scene: 教室里只听得见笔尖划纸的声音，老师念一句就停一下。The class did a dictation of ten sentences.
sceneCN: 这里 dictation 指「听写」（第 2 个义项：把听到的话写下来的练习或测验）；句意是全班做了一次十句的听写。

senses.title: The act of speaking for a writer
senses.definition: the act of saying words aloud for someone else to write down
senses.definitionCN: 把话念出来让别人记录下来的行为
senses.example: She took dictation from the editor for an hour.
senses.exampleCN: 她为编辑做了一小时口述记录。
senses.why: Two people share one text, one speaking and one writing.
senses.whyCN: 两个人共用一篇文字，一个说，一个写。

senses.title: A writing test from speech
senses.definition: a test in which learners write down words that are read aloud
senses.definitionCN: 学习者把念出来的词句写下来的一种测验
senses.example: The class did a dictation of ten sentences.
senses.exampleCN: 全班做了一次十句的听写。
senses.why: The ear is asked to prove that the hand can spell.
senses.whyCN: 耳朵被要求证明，那只手拼得对。

senses.title: The text read out
senses.definition: the words or passage that is read aloud to be written
senses.definitionCN: 被念出来供人记录的那段文字
senses.example: The teacher prepared a short dictation for Monday.
senses.exampleCN: 老师为周一准备了一段短听写材料。
senses.why: The passage is a script waiting for many hands to copy it.
senses.whyCN: 那段文字是一份等许多只手来抄的稿子。

intro.en: Dictation comes from Latin dictatio, from dictare, to say repeatedly, and English adopted it in the sixteenth century.
intro.cn: dictation 来自拉丁语 dictatio，源自动词 dictare（反复说），十六世纪进入英语。

items.en: Dictare meant to say a thing over so that it could be written.
items.cn: dictare 指把一句话说上几遍，好让人写下来。

items.en: Dictatio named that act and the text produced by it.
items.cn: dictatio 指这个行为，也指由此产生的文字。

items.en: English dictation first described a clerk writing at another's voice.
items.cn: 英语 dictation 最初指职员听别人的声音记录。

items.en: Schools turned it into an exercise for teaching spelling.
items.cn: 学校把它变成教拼写的练习。

items.en: It now covers the act, the test and the passage read out.
items.cn: 如今它覆盖这个行为、测验以及念出来的那段文字。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the dict stem, while the meaning group names ways of putting speech into writing.
note.cn: 形近组共用 dict 这个词干，近义组则指把话变成文字的各种方式。

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with pens scratching in a quiet classroom and end with a sheet waiting for many hands.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从安静教室里沙沙的笔尖开始，落到一张等着许多手来抄的纸。

normal.en: Dictation is the noun of a voice handing words to a hand.
normal.cn: dictation 就是声音把词交给手的那个名词。

normal.en: In the classroom the ear must defend the spelling.
normal.cn: 在教室里，耳朵得为拼写作证。

normal.en: A clerk and a student do the same thing at different speeds.
normal.cn: 职员与学生做的是同一件事，只是速度不同。

normal.en: The text read out is a script before it is a test.
normal.cn: 念出来的文字，先是一份稿子，然后才是考题。

normal.en: One voice, many pens, one page.
normal.cn: 一把声音，许多支笔，一页纸。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 dictation 记成「迪克推神」：dict 是说，-ation 是过程，把话一遍遍说出去让人记，就是口述与听写。

root: 来自拉丁语 dictatio，源自动词 dictare（反复说、规定），而 dictare 又来自 dicere（说）。十六世纪进入英语，最初指听人口述做记录，十九世纪被学校用作拼写练习，如今兼指口述行为、听写测验与听写材料。

sensesIntro.en: From a clerk writing at a voice, to a classroom test, to the passage that is read out.
sensesIntro.cn: 从职员听着声音记录，到课堂上的测验，再到被念出来的那段文字。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one voice and many pens moving to the same beat.
core.cn: 核心意象：一把声音与许多支笔，跟着同一个节拍走。

branches.en: The first sense is the working act of voice and hand.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是声音与手配合的工作过程。

branches.en: The second sense is that act turned into a test.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是这个过程变成了考试。

branches.en: The third sense is the text that was read out.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是被念出来的那段文字。

branches.en: Practice and examination use the same slow reading.
branches.cn: 练习与考试，用的是同一种慢速念读。

branches.en: The test and its material are two sides of one sheet.
branches.cn: 测验与它的材料，是一张纸的两面。

intro.en: Dictation belongs to a family about speaking, writing down and the authority of the spoken word.
intro.cn: dictation 属于一族词，关于说、记录以及口头话语的权威。

latinIntro.en: The base dicere means to say, and -ation turns the repeated saying into a process.
latinIntro.cn: 词基 dicere 意为说，后缀 -ation 把反复说变成一个过程。
